Woodwinds {@dice 1d6} thunder damage Light Woodwind instruments fire towards a 60-ft. long, 5-ft. wide line in any direction.
Instrument Type Damage Weap. Prop. Add. Details

feat.name: Deadly Cackler
entries: You have a distinctly strident and powerful cackle that comes naturally whenever you see someone embarass themselves on a whole other level, vicious enough to sink into the brains of those suffering ones. You gain the following benefits:

items: Your Charisma score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Whenever a creature you can see and that can hear you within 120-ft. Critically fails a roll of any kind or suffers the effect of the vicious mockery spell, you belch out a horrible bout of laughter that shakes them to their core, having them instantly take {@dice 1d8} psychic damage and have the next attack rolled against them be made with advantage. This damage increases to {@dice 2d8} when you reach 8th-level and {@dice 3d8} when you reach 14th-level.

entries: At first, all I had to do was be lightly pricked by one of the thorns. Now I have to rub my whole body against it to get the same high.

feat.name: Dismantle Prosthesis

entries: "The Second Smoke War was a conflict between humans and humans who no longer looked the part."

The war caused a divide between the people and whatever the hell the other things were calling themselves. The names don't matter, not to you, what matters is knowing how to tear them bolt by bolt, limb by limb. You have the following when concerning Constructs:

items: You gain 1 {@condition Poise|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} at the start of your turns for each Construct within 30-ft. of you. You gain an additional count for every Construct corpse within that same reach. The maximum amount gained this way is equal to your proficiency bonus.
You inflict 2 {@condition Rupture|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} count against Constructs whenever you deal weapon damage to them.
You have Advantage on {@skill Investigation}, {@skill Perception} and {@skill Survival} skill checks to track or perceive Constructs.

You have Disadvantage on {@skill Insight} checks against Constructs, as your bias will always tell that those machines are built to produce lies. The same Disadvantage applies to Charisma skill checks ( except for {@skill Intimidation} ) against them, due to your tendency towards them being near impossible to conceal.

entries.name: Designer's Note
entries: You may talk with your DM about changing the creature type for any other that might fit! Consider "Faction-Aligned" characters as a choice as well so that they may fit as a suitable target, such as the enemy side of whatever war you may have come to participate in. In general, we recommend using Rangers' Favoured Enemy for a rule-of-thumb of what can categorize as an apt creature type to be chosen by this feature, including choosing two kinds of humanoids.

feat.name: Dissociative Form

prerequisite.other: Wisdom score equal to or below 16.

entries: Comfort in your body was something that was always odd to you, or that has become so recently. This alienation has led you to have a number of effects towards that dissociation, as follows:

items: You have Advantage against any effects that would alter your form, as your recognition of your inherent inability to escape yourself sinks into the very magic that could afflict you.

Whenever you would become {@condition Charmed}, you suffer none of it’s usual effects. Instead you become sharply aware of the presence that attempted to Charm you, always knowing the position of the creature who {@condition Charmed} you as long as it is within the same plane as you and within 120-ft of you. Furthermore, you gain a +2 to Wisdom and Dexterity Saving Throws against that creature. You lose this bonus when you lose the {@condition Charmed} Condition.

Whenever you would become {@condition Frightened}, you suffer none of its usual effects. Instead your knowledge that nothing can truly further warp the cage of which you perceive the world in further has you become more resilient towards what could happen to you. You gain a +2 to Wisdom and Constitution Saving Throws against that creature. You lose this bonus when you lose the {@condition Frightened} Condition.

feat.name: Even Respiration

entries: "Can't let myself be disoriented... till the last moment..."

There is one thing that you must maintain before everything else when surrounded by people of importance: Decorum. For that, you've managed to steel your once quivering hands and manage your breathing to the most respectable level even while under stress, gaining the following:

items: Whenever you would be Surprised you can still use your Reaction on the first turn of combat.

Whenever you would make the first attack you could in your turn, you may choose between instantly spending 15-ft. of movement speed or any other additional attacks you would be able to make as per the Attack Action to grant yourself a +1 bonus modifier to the attack roll per 15-ft./attack spent. Additionally you gain 2 {@condition Poise|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} count before the attack is rolled per 15-ft./attack spent.

feat.name: Eyes of the Heart
entries: You have always carried the emotions of other people and even creatures in your hearts eyes, being able to pick up what most others tend to just ignore or even not realize that they’re seeing - subtle looks down, lips curling towards a smile or even the body language of someone that’s slowly becoming more anxious - it’s all clear to you. Because of that, you gain the following benefits:

items: You gain a +1 to your Wisdom score, to a maximum of 20.
You gain Proficiency in the {@skill Insight} skill, or Expertise if you were already Proficient with it.

You may attempt an {@skill Insight} check against a creature you can see or hear within 60-ft. of you as a free action that can be taken once during your turn. The DM decides this check’s DC if the target is attempting to hide their feelings or simply use the creature’s passive {@skill Deception} score. On a success, you may choose between learning the target’s current remaining Hit Points, the current action they are considering to take or the emotion they are currently feeling. You have Disadvantage on this check if you cannot hear and see the target at the same time.

feat.name: Femme Fatale
entries: You have the mannerisms and know-how of a femme fatale, you actual gender doesn’t matter - What matters is that you know how to captivate and domineer like no other using your words, body language and overwhelming charisma. You gain the following effects:

items: Your Charisma score increases by 1, to a maximum value of 20.

Whenever you deal damage to a {@condition Charmed} creature the condition does not end instantly, instead they must pass an {@skill Insight} check against your choice of a {@skill Persuasion} or {@skill Deception} check at the end of your turn ( if it is your turn ) or after you attack them.
You have advantage on attack rolls against {@condition Charmed} creatures.
You have advantage against effects that would cause you to be {@condition Charmed}.

rows: Minor
Major

feat.name: Filthy Blood
entries: You've experimented with yourself to a point where your blood is a toxic substance or it has always been this way for a reason or another. When a creature would hit you with a bite attack, any bite-adjacent attacks (Such as a peck or any melee attack that would cause your blood to be absorbed) or when it triggers a Critical Hit against you while within 5-ft of you, that creature must pass a Constitution Saving Throw whose DC 14 + Your Constitution Modifier + Your Proficiency Score or become {@condition Poisoned||Poisoned} for one minute, being able to retry this Saving Throw at the end of their subsequent turns, yet also taking {@damage 2d4} poison damage on any further failures after becoming {@condition Poisoned||Poisoned}.

feat.name: Guardian's Aura
entries: The soul of a true defender is the one you show, and with a touch of magic you can push that energy into a barrier for a friend. You gain the following benefits:

items: As an action, choose a friendly creature you can see within 60 feet. For 1 minute while you maintain concentration, that creature gains a +2 bonus to AC. Other creatures have disadvantage on attacks against it unless no other conscious creature friendly to it is within 30 feet.

prerequisite.other: 8th-level, Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma score that is 16 or greater.

feat.name: Guided by the Will

entries: "According to the city's will, its volition... The City's will matches the will of the people living in it."

You are a follower of the Living Will and may have your orders appear to you in a small slip of paper at any given moment, standing by for the next goal. You are able to receive Prescripts in the following ways:

items: As a Free Action during your turn you may draw a Prescript, as per the Follower of an Order Prescripts and the Magicked Prescripts Tables. Upon completion, you gain one {@condition Grace of the Prescript|TheUndertomesFD} which remains until your next short or long rest. Upon failure, you suffer one {@condition Karmic Consequences|TheUndertomesFD} You may do this up to an amount of times equal to half your proficiency bonus per short or long rest, rounded down.

You may choose to draw from the Crawling Prescripts table upon finishing a long rest. Upon its completion, you gain three {@condition Grace of the Prescript|TheUndertomesFD}. Upon a failure you suffer three {@condition Karmic Consequences|TheUndertomesFD} instead.

entries: Additionally the Will benefits you in certain moments of need. Once per turn you may spend one {@condition Grace of the Prescript|TheUndertomesFD} count to re-roll your damage die or a saving throw. You must do so before the DM determines it a success or a failure in the latter case.

prerequisite.other: You have no levels in a Living Will subclass.

feat.name: Heart on a Sleeve
entries: You are a generally compassionate person, being able to empathize even with the oddest folk and creatures to be seen across the lands. This sincere nature has earned you the following effects:

items: Your Charisma score increases by 1, to a maximum value of 20.
Your expectations of sincerity have you suffer disadvantage on {@skill Deception} checks.

Your honesty can break through even the most suspiscious hearts, granting you advantage on {@skill Persuasion} checks when you are being honest, and this also makes it harder for others to have the heart to lie to you, causing them to have disadvantage on their {@skill Deception} checks.

As a bonus action during your turns you may give another creature a phrase of encouragement, granting them an {@dice 1d4} bonus modifier to their next attack roll, skill check or saving throw. You may do this an amount of times equal to your Charisma modifier, restoring spent uses after a long rest.

feat.name: Hearts Cast Aside

entries: "Qui si spoglia l'elmo e la corazza... e getta via la spada Durindana."

Sometimes, your emotions become so turbulent that the only thing you manage to do to claw away from your aching heart is to sever what ties it down. While at half your maximum Hit Points or lower, you may spend your Bonus Action to grip a Magical Item that you are Attuned to in one of your free hands, instantly shattering the item into pieces and inciting a mad fury to beat from your heart, drawing more power to yourself. This power is according to the item's rarity, as follows:

entries.caption: Hearts Cast Aside
rows: Uncommon
You gain a +1 bonus modifier to all your Attack Rolls until the end of combat.
Rare
You gain a +1 bonus modifier to all your Attack Rolls and to your AC until the end of combat.
Very Rare
You gain a +2 bonus modifier to all your Attack Rolls, to your AC and to Strength, Dexterity and Constitution until the end of combat.
Legendary

You gain a +3 bonus modifier to all your Attack Rolls, to your AC, Saving Throws and an {@dice 1d4} bonus modifier to ability checks to all Ability Checks until your next Long Rest. Furthermore, when you would be reduced to one Hit Point you instantly gain half your Maximum Hit Points as Temporary Hit Points. When you gain these Hit Points, you may also let out a guttural scream, causing all creatures within 30-ft. of you to attempt a Strength saving throw or be pushed 10-ft. and become {@condition Frightened} of you for the next minute, or only be pushed back 5-ft. on a success.
Artifact
You gain the same effects as when you would Shattering a Legendary item. Additionally, while having Temporary Hit Points from this feature all damage you deal ignores Resistances and Immunities.

entries: You may use this ability once per Long Rest and the item is cannot be restored through any means other than a {@spell wish} spell. You may use this ability an additional time per Long Rest after reaching 16th-Level. If you attempt to shatter an Artifact, it is instead cracked and loses all its properties for {@dice 1d6} months. You gain the same value rolled in Exhaustion points after your next Long Rest, as your aching heart fails to cease its fervent beating.

feat.name: Ice Legs
entries: After an encounter with powerful ice magic, your body has been changed considerably, giving your legs a constant icy chill. you gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Your speed increases by 10 feet. Additionally, you can spend a bonus action to transform the terrain you walk over into Difficult Terrain until the start of your next turn.

As an action, you can make a melee attack roll against a creature within range. If the attack hits, they take {@dice 1d10} cold damage and suffer 3 counts of {@condition Sinking|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} This damage increases to {@dice 2d10} at level 5, {@dice 3d10} at level 11 and {@dice 4d10} at level 17. This can be used as an opportunity attack reaction.

feat.name: Imitator
entries: You are a master at the art of portraying other people and other things, being able to perfectly mimic others voices and even simple sounds you’ve heard, like a birds song. This doesn’t limit only to your vocal ability, but also to your physical representations, learning mannerisms and ticks with ease. You gain the following abilities:

items: Your Charisma score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain Proficiency in the {@skill Deception} skill, or Expertise if you were already Proficient in it.
While donning a disguise you gain a +3 to {@skill Deception} and {@skill Performance} checks to portray yourself as someone else.

You may spend a minute without taking any other actions or bonus actions to observe a creature you can see and hear that is within 60-ft. of you, or ten minutes for one within 120-ft., learning their voice and mannerisms after that brief research. You can perfectly mimic them afterward.

feat.name: Impaler
entries: To truly make use of a weapon that you drive into a foul beast, you must know to twist it. When you deal piercing damage to a creature through a melee attack you may spend your bonus action to twist the blade or weapon used, dealing an additional d4 of piercing damage equal to half your Proficiency Bonus and inflict that same amount in {@condition Bleed|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Bleed} stacks. You may use this feature up to a number of times equal to your Proficiency Modifier, regaining spent uses on a short or long rest.

feat.name: Ink Thicker Than Blood

prerequisite.other: You aren't of a Middle Subclass

entries: You've found yourself a place in a greater family and it shows in your skin with pride and pomp. When you take this Feature, consider how your character was first introduced to the Middle, how they came to join and how they look up to their older Siblings. Nevertheless, you gain the following:

items: You instantly gain a 3rd level Tattoo of the Middle, as per the Path of Grievance's rules. You gain an additional one upon reaching 6th level, another at 10th and a final one at 14th level.

During combat, the enemy that dealt the most damage to you or your allies this round gains a {@condition Vengeance Mark|TheUndertomesMBG}. This lasts until the end of the next round, or until you fall unconscious. If no enemy has dealt damage this turn, the stack of {@condition Vengeance Mark|TheUndertomesMBG} is given to the enemy that last attempted to attack you or an allied creature. This applies after any other Middle Subclass characters application, going toward the creature that dealt the second most damage if applicable. Outside of combat, whenever someone rolls an ability check to hurt or damage your character or their reputation, they will also gain a point of {@condition Vengeance Mark|TheUndertomesMBG} until your next short rest. If combat is initiated right after an instance of this by rolling an initiative check, then the enemy with the highest initiative roll gains {@condition Vengeance Mark|TheUndertomesMBG} until the end of the first round of combat.
Whenever you hit an enemy with a stack of {@condition Vengeance Mark|TheUndertomesMBG}, they gain 1 stack of {@condition Bleed|TheUndertomesGeneralRules}.

entries: When first you take this Feature you gain a {@item Little Book of Vengeance|TheUndertomesOL} from another Sibling that acts as a courier for you.

feat.name: Lingering Ills
entries: Something in your past has deeply marked you, be that a physical manifestation of a memory that taints your soul or something that happened once and has been on replay inside your mind’s eye ever since. You gain the following:

items: Your Constitution score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain advantage against effects that would cause you to become {@condition Frightened}, as you have already dealt with such a situation for long enough to become used to such feelings.

Choose one damage type to act as an Ill Trigger for you when you first take this feat. It is a base reaction from your body caused from the chosen type reminding you of an important event of your life that has you respond in either Flight or Fight mode, gaining the following benefits as makes sense in the moment:
Fight. You gain a +1 bonus modifier on attack and damage rolls against the source of that damage type but due to desperation your AC is reduced by 1.
Flight. You gain an additional 5-ft. of movement speed per creature within your Ill Trigger’s reach that you have seen deal the chosen damage type, to a maximum of 15-ft.

entries: Your Ill Trigger is triggered whenever you take or see another creature within 30-ft. suffer that damage type. You cannot choose slashing, bludgeoning or piercing damage for this feature.

feat.name: Masked Wounds

entries: "I keep it covered because it hurts to even look at."
You've been horribly disfigured in one way or another that left part of your body ever-aching, and you've procured a means to mask such a painful memory. You gain the following:

items: You always have a means to procure a way to mask your wound, instantly recovering one roll of your Hit Die in Hit Points during a short rest.

Whenever your current Hit Points are reduced to or below half their Maximum Value, you enter a {@condition Sizzling Wound|TheUndertomesFD} state, as your pain soars to an unbearable amount, causing your mind to fully focus on drenching that wound in blood to quench the aching.

entries: While in this state your AC is reduced by 2 and you deal an additional 1d6 fire damage when dealing damage, also inflicting {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} count equal to half your proficiency bonus. If the attack already deals fire damage, inflict a count equal to your proficiency bonus instead.
This state lasts until your next short rest or you recover all your Hit Points.

feat.name: Modified
entries: You were the subject of scientific experimentation and have become something beyond what you once were, against your will or not. You gain the following benefits:

items: Your Constitution Score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You have Advantage on Cosntitution saving throws and cannot have your form altered against your will.
Most people feel bad for your state when they see you, granting you a +2 bonus on {@skill Persuasion} skill checks against them.

feat.name: Never Again.
entries: During your life, there was a moment or another where you believe you should've said goodbye, that you could've said something different, and to this day you feel like so much could have been better if you did.

You've learned from your previous mistakes. When your party would be split in separate groups, such as you going to check out a tavern while others sneak around the back, you may give your fellows a pep-talk or any form of encouragement that you'll see each other soon. When you do so, they gain a Longing Die that they may use in any roll before you reunite.

This Longing Die is initially a d6. At 8th level this Longing Die becomes a d8, and upon reaching 16th level it becomes a d10. Whenever a creature adds a Longing Die to their roll, it becomes one step lesser, such as a d6 becoming a d4. When a Longing Die is rolled as a d4, it is then lost.

feat.name: Never Erring Paragon
entries: No temptation shall ever come to pass in your life, as your mind is a temple, sacred and well-kept. You gain the following benefits: Your Wisdom score increaes by 1, to a maximum of 20. You have advantage against being deceived or coerced into performing actions you do not wish to do, or speaking what you do not want to speak.
You gain advantage on saving throws against being {@condition Charmed||charmed} or {@condition Frightened||frightened}.

feat.name: Not a Trace of Gasoline
entries: Allows you to overextend the perceived fuel of your gauntlet into one devastating punch. Your Fire Breathing Hand Action fires out a 30-ft long cone of flame instead, with its DC being increased by half your Proficiency Bonus, rounded down, dealing {@dice 4d8} damage instead of {@dice 3d4} and inflicting a total of 8 {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} count.

feat.name: Old Faith
entries: Your devotion to your deity may be ancient, yet still eroding.
Despite your wish to remain faithful, there are lapses in your belief that grant you the following:

items: Your choice between your Wisdom or Intelligence scores increase by 1, to a maximum of 20.

When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you makes an ability check, saving throw, or attack roll, you can use your Reaction to roll a d100. On a result of 51 or higher, the creature adds a +5 bonus to its roll. On a result of 50 or lower, the creature subtracts 5 from its roll.

entries: You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

feat.name: Overwatch

entries: "Must focus on resolving the task at hand first..."

You know well that firing a gun at a target to kill isn't all there is to ranged combat, and that a tactical approach might be best while on the battlefield. To ensure that, you've developed a methodical firing pattern to lock down your opponents, gaining the following:

items: You may use your Action to create a Supressing Zone.

entries.name: Supressing Zone.
entries: You spend your Action to lock down an area in heavy fire. When do so your remaining movement speed becomes 0 and you suffer a -2 modifier to Dexterity saving throws until the start of your next turn. You then choose between having that are be a 15-ft. wide line reaching up to your weapon's long range or a cone reaching up to its short-range.

For the same duration whenever a creature first moves within the area you may instantly may make a ranged attack roll against that creature, dealing damage as usual and reducing their movement speed by half its total amount on a hit.

Additionally, that area is considered Difficult Terrain for the duration. After the duration passes you are considered to be out of ammunition as per the Reload property and if you had less than half the ammunition you could carry in your magazine your attack rolls must be done at Disadvantage for the duration.

feat.name: Perfected Breathing
entries: Shortness of breath is something foreign to you nowadays, having dutifuly trained your ability to intake air so you need not worry about it ever again. You gain the following benefits:

items: Your Constitution Attribute score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You can hold your breath for at least half an hour.

When you would fail an {@skill Athletics} or {@skill Acrobatics} skill check you may try to steady your breathing and push out the last amount of effort you can put into the task at hand, gaining a {@dice 1d6} bonus modifier to the roll, potentially turning that failure into a success. You may use this ability an amount of times equal to half your proficiency bonus, rounded down. You restore spent uses on a short or long rest.

feat.name: Primed and Ready to Go
entries: At the start of any battle, you're a force to be reckoned with due to your absolutely explosive starts. You gain the following benefits: Your Strength or Dexterity scores increase by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain a +2 bonus to hit and in damage rolls, yet that bonus is reduced by one each time you use Action Surge, SecondWind. or or Indomitable Indomitable, as you become more winded for the fight in general, with this bonus being restored after a long rest.

feat.name: Red Eyes of the Hunter
entries: Your eyes have taken to dark places and those who are difficult to navigate, all in search of prey. While you are actively tracking a creature or an object, your irises shine in a piercing red, and you can see through non-magical darkness. You gain proficiency in the perception skill, or Expertise if you were already had proficient in it.

You may use {@skill Perception} in place of {@skill Survival} or {@skill Investigation} skills when attempting to track a creature or object. Additionally, you gain Darkvision if you didn't have it already, seeing in shades of red, seeing up to 60-feet in darkness as if it were bright light and darkness as if in dim light.

prerequisite.other: 4th Level, at least a +4 modifier to Perception

feat.name: Repose of the Butterflies
entries: The dead follow you, not as putrid remains reanimated to slave away at your will, but as gentle spirits which follow your guidance. When you gain this feat, you also gain the following: Your Charisma or Wisdom score increases by 1. When you cast the {@spell spare the dying|PHB|Spare the Dying} spell, you may instead choose to free the soul of a creature from its body and transform it into a White Butterfly, which uses the Tressym sheet for itself.

When freed this way, the fragile butterfly may be used instead of the creatures original body for reviving it. The butterfly created by this retains the memories and personality of its last life, with the change that it is now in a constant state of serenity. It may choose by itself if it would rather fly away and disappear into whatever afterlife might exist in its world or stay with you.
You may ask the butterfly one question per day, with them responding with their voice emanating inside your head.

prerequisite.other: Know the Spare the Dying spell.

feat.name: Retaliator

entries: "Non trova pace il cor, né quiete il petto, se non vendica l'ira e'l suo disdegno."
The world might beat and beat and beat you, but you never back down, not fully. You always end up striking back with all your might, granting the following benefits:

items: Whenever you suffer damage from another creature within your attack reach you may spend your Reaction to perform a weapon attack against them. You may also instead use a damaging cantrip to do so instead of a weapon attack.

feat.name: Ribcage Protection
entries: You are able to extend your ribcage out of your body without any physical pain to you, but not without consequences. As a reaction to being attacked, you an increase your AC by 5 until the start of your next turn, however, you suffer a -3 penalty to all ability checks, attack rolls and saving throws.
You can use this ability a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses on a long rest.

feat.name: Sacrificial Heart
entries: You were always one that is ready to give for the sake of others no matter the cost for yourself, and that hasn't changed one bit.

Before performing an attack roll against another creature you may choose to give it your all, harming yourself while trying to deter evil: you suffer two rolls of your Hit Die in damage that cannot be reduced by any means.
Afterward you instantly gain a +1 modifier to hit and deal an additional damage die whose type is the same as the attack’s.
Whenever you do this you may spend an additional pair of Hit Die to further increase this bonus, to a maximum value of 6 Hit Die for a +3 modifier and 3 additional damage Die.
When you do this, you also lose the ability to use those Hit Die on a long rest.
Your Constitution Score increases by one when you take this feat, to a maximum of 20.

feat.name: Sadist
entries: You’ve always derived a particular joy from the suffering of others, even moreso when you are the one to inflict it. You gain the following benefits:

items: Your choice of your Strength, Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma attribute score increases by one, to a maximum of 20.

You gain a +1 bonus modifier for Wisdom saving throws whenever a creature you can see within 120-ft of you is knocked {@condition Unconscious}, dies or suffers a Critical Hit. This bonus can go up to your proficiency bonus’ value and is reduced to zero at the end of combat.

You gain a +1 bonus modifier to your damage rolls whenever you land a Critical Hit against a creature you are attacking or when you kill a creature. This bonus can go up to your proficiency bonus’ value and is reduced by one at the end of your turn if you haven’t caused it to increase.

feat.name: See Things Through
entries: Things don't always go your way, but you're fine with that, because you never quit right away. You gain the following benefits:

items: When you fail an ability check, you can use your reaction to reroll it with a -2 penalty. You can do this only once per roll and a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

feat.name: Seen Buddy
entries: You have created a simulated life with your arcane prowess, evolving a simple {@spell Unseen Servant} into a true person who vanishes in and out of reality like a blink of an eye! When you cast the {@spell Unseen Servant} spell, your {@spell Unseen Servant} is instead a Seen Buddy, having the following changes:

It is not mindless, being able to feel and think as if it were it’s own creature. It is fine with it’s nature as a magical construct and has a personality of your choice, remembering events between castings of the spell and, at your choice, being able to linger as an incorporeal form that wanders around 30-ft of you even if the spell is not active, being able to project it’s voice whenever. It has a friendly disposition to you and creatures of your choice, following your orders with pride.

items: All it’s Attribute Scores are 16, except for it’s Charisma, which is 18.
The servant can be seen at your will, with the ability to become unseen as part of your bonus action command to them. It’s appearance is that of your choice when casting this spell.
You may order the servant to aid a creature within 15-ft of it, having it take the Help action towards the target creature.
If it is dispelled through anti-magic areas ( Such as the Antimagic Field spell and not the Dispel Magic spell ) the servant loses it’s memories.

entries: One of your Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma scores also increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

feat.name: Shield and Sword
entries: Your studies have led you to a place where you can allow yourself not only to go unhurt, but punish those who would dare attack you. As part of your reaction when you cast the {@spell shield|PHB|Shield} spell, if the attack that would hit you was turned into a miss, you may also cause a burst of arcane swords to pierce out off of your shield, instantly dealing {@damage 2d12} force damage back to the attacker.

prerequisite.other: Know the Shield spell and have 3rd level spell slots available.

feat.name: Silent Songweaver

prerequisite.other: You have proficiency in at least 3 intruments

entries: To you a song is carried not only by loud notes and a flurry of ear-piercing vocalizations, but instead through hummed melodies and soft, nearly imperceptible symphonies that slowly encroach toward others to in time crash like a magnificent wave. You gain the following:

items: Your Charisma score increases by 1, to a maximum value of 20.
You have advantage on {@skill Stealth} checks to hide Verbal components when casting a spell.

When you take the Ready action during your turn to cast a spell, you may have it’s trigger be the start of your next turn, slowly building up a crescendo. You add a +1 bonus modifier to the spell if it requires an attack roll to hit targets or the same modifier to your Spell Save DC for the spell.

If you are Hidden, you may spend your action to suddenly start playing an instrument you are wielding loudly, forcing any creature you are hidden from to attempt a Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition Frightened} of you for the next minute, being able to retry this saving throw at the end of their turns. The DC for this saving throw is 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier.

entries: The performance does not end. And Da capo. And, Da capo al Fine
Silent Orchestra

feat.name: Stakehunter's Instincts
entries: You're experienced at hunting the beasts of blood that haunt the realm. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with {@item Serrated Hand-axe|TheUndertomesTO|Serrated Handaxes}, Stakes, and {@item Stake Crossbow|TheUndertomesTO|Stake Crossbows}.
You gain a +2 bonus to ability checks made to perceive or track Vampires, {@race Bloodfiend|TheUndertomesTO|Bloodfiends}, or another creature that subsists solely on blood.

feat.name: Targeted Relief
entries: There's some sort of monstrous being that really ticks you off, to a point where their losses outright give you life. When you take this feat, choose one from the following creature types: aberrations, beasts, celestials, constructs, dragons, elementals, fey, fiends, giants, monstrosities, oozes, plants, or undead.

When a creature of this type is reduced to 0 hit points for the first time in an hour, you may become invigorated with satisfaction, giving you an {@dice 1d4} bonus to skill checks, attack rolls and saving throws until your next turn, or up to one minute when outside of combat. This does not work on summoned creatures such as those created from magic items such as a Bag of Pests or spells like the Summon Elementals spell.

feat.name: The Fair Justiciar
entries: Your tenets will be followed, as that is the true justice! Whenever a creature you can see and hear breaks one of your subclass' tenets, you may spend your reaction to fuel your desire to correct such behaviour. You gain half your proficiency modifier as a bonus on any Charisma based skill checks, {@skill Insight} checks and attack rolls against that creature for the next minute.
You may use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier, regaining expended uses after a long rest.

feat.name: Thornskin
entries: Your body is covered in small thorns that react to the touch.
You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

As a reaction when someone hits you with a melee attack, you can force them to make a Wisdom saving throw (save DC = 10 + your Charisma modifier + your proficiency bonus). If they fail, they are {@condition Charmed} by you until the start of your next turn.

feat.name: Throes of Rejection
entries: There is a wound within you that will never heal, and every small "no" you hear only pokes at the scabs. As such, when you are neglected by a creature during a social interaction, you may channel this frustration in further actions. Whenever you are rejected, you gain one Frustration Dice.

Those are d4s and you may have up to your proficiency modifiers worth of them at any given time, and you may spend them when you fail skill checks to use your frustration to seek success, although scuffed. However, you have a disadvantage equal to one roll of your Frustration Dice against any creature who had caused you to gain one within the last week. Hemorrhaging Weapon Property.

A serrated weapon causes a stack of {@condition Bleed|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} whenever you hit with it, provided the roll equals the value presented alongside the property before any modifiers. {@condition Bleed|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} A bleeding bleed creature is well, creature is well, bleeding bleed ! You take {@dice 1d4} damage when you performany action ( Each attack is considered a different action, this also includes Bonus Actions and Reactions, but not Free Actions ), and then is reduced by one count. You may heal or have {@condition Bleed|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} fully removed if you or another creature passes a succesful medicine check on you.

The DC for this is 10 + The number of counts you currently have. If you have only one count of {@condition Bleed|TheUndertomesGeneralRules}, it will not be removed upon taking damage and must be removed through a medicine check.

feat.name: Trench Warfare Expert

entries: "Looks like my past self has faced some tough battles, too."
You've become used to combat in cramped spaces as you have gone through your life, benefitting the most while dragging others to your zone of command. You gain the following:

items: You gain Advantage on melee weapon attacks made within enclosed spaces or while being Flanked.

entries: Enclosed spaces count has having walls or similarly impassable objects covering at least two opposite spaces around a 5-ft. radius of you. Large or greater creatures count as walls for the purposes of this feature.

feat.name: Trust in Intuition
entries: For the vast majority of your life you have always wandered where your body took you, have seen what your eyes wished to see and have chosen a direction to aim toward of your hearts choice. Intuition is your primary driving force, and it is all you trust in. You gian the following effects:

items: Your Wisdom score increases by 1, to a maximum value of 20.

You gain Expertise in the {@skill Insight} skill and may use it in place of {@skill Investigation} and {@skill Perception} skill checks when such would be asked of you. You may do this a maximum amount of times equal to your proficiency bonus, recovering spent uses after a long rest.

You may choose to instead of attempting a skill check, attack roll or saving throw, name a number form 1-6 and rolling a d6. If the number you’ve named is the result, you succeed in whatever you were attempting. If the number is wrong, you fail. You may do this only once per long rest.

feat.name: Turned Bloodbag
entries: You were turned into a Bloodbag by your sire. You gain the following benefits:

items: Your Wisdom and Intelligence scores each decrease by 1, to a minimum of 5.

entries.name: Blood Arts
entries: You learn two Blood Arts from the {@race Bloodfiend|TheUndertomesTO|Bloodfiend} ancestry:

entries.optionalfeature: In the Dark of the Night|TheUndertomesTO

entries.name: It's in the Blood
entries: When a creature with blood drops below 1 hit point because of your actions, you gain 1 Blood Charge. You can also use an action to extract blood from a corpse that has been dead for less than 1 day. You can hold up to 10 Blood Charges and spend them to fuel your Blood Arts.
You take a penalty to saving throws against enchantment spells cast by your sire equal to your sire's Charisma modifier, and you have disadvantage on those saving throws.

feat.name: Turned Kindred
entries: You were turned into the next generation of {@race Bloodfiend|TheUndertomesTO|Bloodfiend} by your sire. You gain the following benefits:

entries.name: Blood Arts
entries: You learn two Blood Arts from the {@race Bloodfiend|TheUndertomesTO|Bloodfiend} ancestry:

entries.optionalfeature: In the Dark of the Night|TheUndertomesTO

entries.name: It's in the Blood
entries: When a creature with blood drops below 1 hit point because of your actions, you gain 1 Blood Charge. You can also use an action to extract blood from a corpse that has been dead for less than 1 day. You can hold up to 10 Blood Charges and spend them to fuel your Blood Arts.
You take a penalty to saving throws against enchantment spells cast by your sire equal to your sire's Charisma modifier.

feat.name: United Hunt
entries: Nothing creates a bond like a good hunt between a tight-knit crew, and you know that. Afterall, slaying a beast together will be much more effective. As someone who knows how to make the most of it, you gain the following benefits:

You gain a +1 to hit against creatures that have been hit by a friendly creature before you in a combat round. When you receive or give help in skill checks to perceive or track a creature, add a furhter +2 bonus to the dice rolled.

feat.name: Vestigial Killer
entries: The last moments of the dead are some you hold near and dear to your heart, after all, what doesn’t kill you makes you stronger and these remnants of the past can be used as weapons of your own. You gain the following effects:

items: Your choice of Strength, Dexterity or Constitution Attribute Score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Whenever you suffer an attack from a creature and aren’t knocked {@condition Unconscious}, you may spend your Reaction to learn the attack used against you, granting you the ability to perform it using the original creature’s attack modifier or yours when you do so. You may have up to half your proficiency modifier’s worth of attacks learnt like this and they must be physical attacks, as in ones that require no magical effect and you have a similar weapon to make use of them, such as having a longbow to perform ranged techniques and so on.

feat.name: Vorpal Instinct
entries: There is no greater rush than when you sever a creature's head from its body. When you would kill a creature through a melee weapon attack, you may choose to viscerally decapitate it, casting fear into your foes hearts. As you do so, choose one creature within 30-feet of yourself, it must make a Wisdom Saving Throw or become {@condition Frightened} of you until the end of your next turn.

A creature that is immune to being {@condition Frightened||frightened} instead only gains advantage against this check. The DC for this Wisdom Saving Throw is 8 +Your Strength or Dexterity modifier ( Choosen when you take this feat ) + your Proficiency Bonus.

feat.name: Well Trained
entries: You have spent years of your life honing a particular set of skills, to the point of being unmatched by most others in your field. You gain the following:

items: One of your Attribute scores increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain Expertise in one skill of the chosen Attribute, and Proficiency in any other skill of your choice.
When rolling a Skill Check for either chosen skills, you add a {@dice 1d4} bonus modifier to that roll.

spell.name: Aberrant Apuncture
entries: Good arrows pierce the heart and make a body cease functions, great arrows pierce the brain and make a person be less of themselves. You invoke a giant arrow, tendril or lance of dark, cosmic energy which ebbs and flows with noises that you can never quite understand. Make a ranged spell attack against one creature within range, on a hit, the creature takes {@damage 1d10} piercing damage plus {@damage 2d4} cold damage, additionally the creature has their current feelings emptied away and replaced with a momentary void.

It cannot feel that feeling until they are cured by a spell such as {@spell greater restoration|PHB|Greater Restoration} or Remove curse, as an example, a berzerking barbarian who suffers this will not be able to feel their anger until then. The creature suffers disadvantage to any skill checks that would be acting upon such a feeling, following the example a creature without its anger would have disadvantage for {@skill Intimidation} checks, or a creature without its adoration could have disadvantage imposed to it when attempting to Persuade another. This creature feels a void upon their chest until cured.

spell.name: Accelerando Formas

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the target creature may perform one more melee weapon attack against creatures within reach for each second slot level above 5th, performing two attacks when this spell is cast at 7th level and three attacks on spending a 9th level spell slot.

You link your playing of a melody with another creatures ability to move, raising up your speed dramatically so they may zoom across the battlefield in the blink of an eye. You touch a friendly creature of your choice and imbue them with a speedy link, making it so they can move up to their movement speed after you cast this spell. During this movement this creature may perform a melee weapon attack against any creature they come across, becoming immune to Opportunity Attacks until the end of your turn.

spell.name: Arms of the Spider
entries: You conjure the disembodied gigantic, spindly legs of a spider near a target creature within range. It must pass a Dexterity saving throw or suffer from the spider perfectly weaving a Cocoon around most of its body, rendering it {@condition Grappled||grappled} until the Cocoon is broken. On a success, the creature takes {@damage 2d4} piercing damage as the legs nick its body from the rampant movement.
The Cocoon has 50 hit points, 12 AC and weakness to fire damage. After being destroyed the Cocoon slowly crumbles into white dust.

spell.name: Assimilate Shell
entries: The body is nothing but a skin to be worn over the flesh, and clothing like that is meant to be switched every once in a while. You conjure a ritual to wear another creature's skin by providing their fresh corpse, it must be dead for less than a week. During the ritual, you etch arcane symbols in both your and their body, chanting all the while.

After this spell is done, you phase into their body and gain +1 to your Charisma score if theirs was higher. You gain any abilities and features the creature had, including inheriting its maximum hit points as temporary hit points, which cannot be restored when your shell is damaged. While wearing your shell, you inherently can mimic their usual tendencies and speech, gaining advantage on any checks to pass as them.
If your temporary hit points during this are reduced below 1, the shell violently bursts in an explosion of gore, revealing your true self.

spell.name: Atelier Logic Caliber
entries: Have you wanted a smart, heat-seeking round? The Atelier Logic Caliber Bullet is laid in silver and expensive, extravagant technology to maximize its hit chance.

When used, you make a ranged weapon attack against a target within your range, you have a +3 to hit with this bullet. This attack's Critical Hit range is changed to a minimum of SL-20. On a Critical Hit, this attack instantly kills a creature with SL * 25 Hit Points or lower.

spell.name: Baba Yaga's Mystical House
entries: You conjure a living shack that follows your commands and can only be entered when it’s gigantic chicken legs are lowered. The house is 30-ft tall and 30-ft wide, with it’s chicken legs elevating it’s height to a total of 50-ft. Its doors and windows lead to an extradimensional dwelling with a moderate number of chambers, having all the nescessary chambers for a dwelling and an alchemy and arcane research room, library and a chamber of holding cells.

You may create any floor plan you like, but this space can’t exceed 30 cubes, each cube being 10 feet on each side. The house is furnished and decorated as you choose, but contains no supplies when first summoned, only retaining anything left inside it whenever this spell is cast afterward. If the Mystical House is destroyed, it and its contents are fully restored when the spell is next cast. The Mystical House uses the {@creature Baba Yaga’s Mystical House|TheUndertomesASV} creature sheet and rolls it’s own Initiative count if in combat, obeying all your orders or taking whatever action nescessary to kill a creature that has damaged it or simply spending all its movement speed moving away from the encounter if not provoked or ordered to attack.

You may spend your Action to call upon a psychical link to the house and command it to come closer, making it appear within an unocuppied space within reach after an amount of time equalling 1 minute per mile apart from the house.

entries.name: Duration
entries: Until destroyed or until this spell is cast by you again.

spell.name: Baleful Brand

components.m: a crumpled paper with your genuine hopes and dreams

entries: You clasp your hands together and wring writing out of thin air, manifesting your magic into solidified threats that erode all it touches. You then point toward a creature within reach, performing a ranged spell attack against them. On a hit, the target suffers {@damage 6d10} psychic damage and suffers from their heart being slowly eroded. Until the end of the targets turn after their next turn, anytime it would suffer damage it suffers an additional 4 points of acid damage that cannot be reduced by any means. Furthermore, whenever the target ends their turn ( including the turn where this effect ends ) they suffer 10 acid damage that also cannot be reduced in any way.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, you may choose one additional target within reach for each slot level above 5th.

spell.name: Belch Flame

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you deal an additional d4 fire damage and inflict 1 {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} count for each second slot level above 2nd.

You bite into a piece of charcoal as if it were an apple, bursting the material components in your mouth and then spitting out a blazing inferno into a 30-ft long cone in front of you, forcing all creatures inside to pass a Dexterity Saving Throw or suffer {@dice 2d4} fire damage and 3 {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} count, or half that fire damage on a success and no condition inflicted.
If there are more than four creatures within that reach the heat spreads more intensely, dealing an additional d4 of fire damage and 2 {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} count.

spell.name: Bestow Serenity
entries: You conjure a handful bright pearls around you, all glowing with an aura of serenity all around them. You may choose up to three willing creatures within range to bestow these pearls to, for the duration, they heal for {@damage 2d8} hit points at the start of their turns as the pearl attaches to their armor, clothing or weapon as if it were always there, and the creatures feel a calm upon their shoulders, additionally granting them advantage on saving throws against becoming {@condition Frightened||frightened}. If a creature would leave the range of this spell, the pearl cracks as its connection is betrayed, having the creature take an amount of d8 of psychic damage equal to how many were used for their healing so far.

When this spells duration is finished or you dismiss it as a bonus action, the pearls slowly turn to a sugary tasting dust. At Higher Levels: When this spell is cast at a level higher than 2nd, it heals an additional {@damage 1d8} hit points per turn per spell slot above 2nd.

spell.name: Binding Chains
entries: You reach out your hand toward a target within reach, swirling your arm as five flashes of light appear around them and soon transforming into burning bright chains that bind them. You choose one target within reach to perform a Strength saving throw, becoming bound for the duration on a failure. They may re-attempt this saving throw at the end of their turns.
While bound, the target has their movement speed halved and a negative modifier to their Attack Rolls, Dexterity and Constitution saving throws equal to your proficiency bonus.

entries.name: Singleton
entries: The target also suffers the same negative modifier to Strength and Wisdom saving throws.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you may target an additional creature within range for each slot level above 4th.

spell.name: Birth Friendship
entries: You make a new friend burst from rotting flesh and bone. Choose a corpse within reach; for the casting duration, its chest slowly swells into a cocoon, its heart growing until it pops, a {@creature Gift Friend|TheUndertomesASF} slithering out of the chasm left behind. The corpse is left utterly mangled, not even edible anymore.

The {@creature Gift Friend|TheUndertomesASF} remains friendly to you as long as you create no more {@creature Gift Friend|TheUndertomesASF|Gift Friends}. If you do so, the older of the two becomes jealous, hostile, and uncontrollable.

spell.name: Bloodbath for a Throne
entries: The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack during the spell's duration, your weapon nearly shatters on your grip as pure divine power flows through it, causing you to deal an additional {@damage 2d8} radiant damage on a hit and forcing all hostile creatures within 10-ft of the initial hit target to pass a Constitution Saving Throw or take the same amount of damage. For any creature that is killed or knocked {@condition Unconscious||Unconscious} from this damage, all hostile creatures within range suffer an additional {@damage 2d8} radiant damage and then are inflicted with 4 {@condition Rupture|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} count, as the space around you crackles and breaks.

entries.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the radiant damage dealt by all effects increases by {@dice 1d8} and you deal an additional 2 counts of {@condition Rupture|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Blooming Manifestation

components.m: a handful of petals or leaves

entries: You toss three petals into the air and have the winds guide them to be buried in different unoccupied spots in the ground, causing them to quickly bloom into small branches that twitch and grow with unstable magic. Whenever a hostile creature moves into or around 5-ft. of one of these Branches, the Branch quickly moves to whip and grab at them, absorbing their willpower for sustenance. That creature must pass a Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition Prone}, take {@damage 2d6} bludgeoning damage and 3 {@condition Sinking|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} count. On a success, the Branch simply whiffs and remains in place.

Upon hitting a creature a Branch blooms and becomes a regular, yet beautiful plant. All others that have not bloomed simply shrivelling up and dying after the spell's duration passes or your Concentration is broken.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you create an additional Branch for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Bones of Meat
entries: You conjure forth a small white flower bearing green fruit in an empty 5-foot space within reach, and it takes root deep down below. When a creature first moves into this flowers space, the roots start unwinding into a messy mass of flesh and teeth, flinging itself up to crash down violently at its assailer. This creature must pass a Dexterity Saving throw or take {@damage 4d12} slashing damage and be {@condition Frightened} of you for the next minute, taking half damage on a success.

After being stepped on, the flower is trampled and the space may be moved into freely and safely. The {@condition Frightened} creature may also attempt a Charisma saving throw to break free from the condition at the end of its turns. At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 1d12} for each slot level above 6th.

spell.name: Booster Shot
entries: Instead of the usual shell, this piece of ammunition is a syringe which will inject its contents upon piercing a target. When used, you may choose any creature within your Marksman Weapon's range, firing a healing round at them. They are healed by {@dice SLd6|SL d6} hit points and gain a +2 bonus to Constitution Saving Throws against being poisoned for the next hour, as the medicine strengthens their immune system temporarily.

spell.name: Brainburst Bullet
entries: Sometimes the best choice is to fully attempt to break a targets mind before their body. When used, you force a target creature within your range to attempt a Charisma Saving Throw, on a success they take {@dice 3d4} psychic damage. On a failure, they take {@dice 3d4} psychic damage upon failing and suffer an additional {@dice 2d4} psychic damage at the end of each of their subsequent turns, as the bullet pulses with psionic energy that causes massive aching. This lasts for up to one minute and the target may attempt the Charisma Saving Throw again after suffering the psychic damage at the end of their turn. On a success, the effect ends early but they suffer a parting echo of the psionic pain, taking {@dice 4d8} psychic damage.

spell.name: Broken Match
entries: You lit the match between your fingers and use it to draw out four symbols of floating ember in the air, connecting them to up to three {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burning} creatures within range. You then strike through all these symbols with the match, instantly making it and the target creatures burst in flame.

These target creatures instantly suffer the effects of their {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} count twice, halving their count each time they suffer it. If a target is suffering from {@condition Tremor - Scorch|TheUndertomesGeneralRules}, you may choose to trigger {@condition Tremor - Scorch|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} once instead.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the targets must pass a Wisdom saving throw or suffer an amount burn count after triggering the Condition equal to three times each slot level above 3rd on a failure.

spell.name: Butterfly's Dragpath
entries: You make a rift in space appear at a point within range, to where a massive blazing talon bears down and drags through a 30-ft. long, 10-ft. wide line of your choice. This area is engulfed in flame for the duration, causing any creature inside that area to suffer 2 {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} count whenever they end or start their turn atop the area.

This flame cannot be put out by non-magical water or wind, but will be extinguished by effects such as the {@spell gust of wind} spell. Surmountable fuel may be thrown into the fire as a Bonus Action, such as an Oil (Flask), causing it to rage on stronger and deal an additional {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} count whenever the Condition is applied. The same happens through spells such as {@spell grease} being cast atop this zone, also effectively expanding its area to cover wherever it is covered by the {@spell grease} spell.
This fire may deal a total of 6 {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} count per turn start or end.

spell.name: Cacophonous Gramophone

components.m: An actual Gramophone and a chunk off of a broken meteor.

entries: You conjure forth a haunting melody to play out of a phantom gramophone, its sound is usually almost alien in nature, and you can choose which creatures can suffer its true melody. All creatures beside yourself within the area must pass a Charisma Saving throw on the start of their turn or suffer {@damage 2d4} psychic damage and suffer a -2 penalty to their Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saving throws until the start of their next turn. On a success, they only take half the psychic damage.
When you cast this spell, you may choose up to three creatures to automatically pass the Saving Throw caused by this spell.

spell.name: Candlesetting
entries: You conjure three red candles in unoccupied spaces of your choice within range that float in the air as if they have been affixed to empty space. These look like strips of tallow interwoven, and may be alight by a creature hitting them with a melee attack ( They have an AC of 14 ) or by spending their Bonus Action to do so.

After being set alight, these candles' bursting flames cling and surround the weapons of creatures of your choice within 15-ft. of each respective candle, having them deal one {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} count on melee weapon attack hits for the duration.

Lit candles are small sized objects that have an amount of Maximum Hit Points equal to 4 times the spell slot level used to cast this spell. Upon falling below one Hit Point, the candle becomes unlit and must be lit again. These candles have a +0 modifier to saving throws except for Constitution and Charisma, to which they use a bonus modifier equal to half the spell slot level used to cast this spell. They also Resist fire damage and are Vulnerable to cold and thunder damage.

A creature may benefit from dealing up an amount of additional {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} count from this spell's effects equal to 2 plus the spell slot level used to cast this spell.

If this spell is cast at 6th level or higher you may meld up to two Candles into the same space, causing them to become a pillar of tallow and flame that grants two {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} additional count instead of one and have a range of 30-ft. instead. These Candles count as medium sized objects and have Maximum Hit Points equal to 8 times the spell slot level.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you summon an additional Candle for each spell slot used above 3rd.

spell.name: Cascading Cataclysm
entries: You click your tongue in a frequency that causes flames to burst out and rage in a blazing howl. One {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burning} creature within reach must pass a Dexterity saving throw or combust violently, suffering an amount of {@damage d8} fire damage equal to half their current {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} count ( To a maximum of {@damage 6d8} ) and suffering the same value of {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} count, ( Max. 6 ) or half that damage and count.

All creatures within 15-ft. of the initial target must pass a Dexterity saving throw or suffer half that damage and count. If the initial target failed, you may choose to have one already {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burning} creature within that reach make a Wisdom saving throw instead, causing them to explode on a failure and suffer the same as the initial effects of this spell.

You may make creatures explode in this way for an amount of times equal to the Spell Slot Level spent to cast this spell, and must always target a creature who has not yet attempted this spell's Wisdom saving throw to explode.

spell.name: Celestial Eyes

components.m: a piece of parchment full of prayers

entries: You touch up to three willing creatures and bless them with the ability to peer through all veils that would be placed upon their heads. For the duration, those creatures have Blindsight of 60 feet.

Any creature benefitting from this may spend a Reaction to when they first see a creature who is either {@condition invisible} or in the ethereal realm to bring them to light, making them visible and bringing them to the material plane ( On the closest unnocupied space ) respectively. This takes form as a divine light shining from under them, making their presence known to all.

spell.name: Chain Wrapping
entries: You summon heavy chains out of the ground, made of it’s same material to bind a creature down and to drain their energy from inside out, as if a vine parasiting from an animal.
You choose one creature within reach to be the target of this spell, forcing them to pass a Dexterity saving throw or be bound by chains for the duration. While bound, they suffer the following:

items: Their movement speed becomes 0, and they can’t benefit from any bonus to its speed.
Attack rolls against the creature have advantage, and the creature’s attack rolls have disadvantage.
The target has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws and suffers 3 Sinking at the start of it’s turns.

entries: To break out, the chained target can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC. On a success, the target escapes and is no longer {@condition restrained} by the hand.

spell.name: Chronal Disruption
entries: {@i Chronurgy spell.}

You target a creature within range and plunge it outside its timestream for a moment, causing it to feel as if it were pricked by pins. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 3d6} bludgeoning damage, suffers 4 {@condition Tremor|TheUndertomesGeneralRules}, and loses either its next bonus action or its next reaction, chosen by you. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and suffers half as much {@condition Tremor|TheUndertomesGeneralRules}, rounded down.

entries.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by {@damage 1d6} and the {@condition Tremor|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} increases by 1 for each slot level above 2nd. Both are halved on a successful saving throw.

spell.name: Combustion Snap
entries: You snap your fingers together, causing a burst of flame to abruptly erupt at the surface of another creature's body. You make one ranged spell attack against that creature, dealing {@damage 1d4} fire damage and 1 {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} count on a hit.

You create more than one burst when you reach higher levels: two bursts at 5th level, three bursts at 11th level and four bursts at 17th level. You can cause these bursts at the same target or at different ones. Make a separate attack roll for each target, hitting or missing all bursts dedicated to the same target depending on the result.

If you could deal additional {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} count on hits through external effects, you may only deal up to half your proficiency bonus' worth of the count per burst instead.

spell.name: Conductors Orders
entries: You pool up arcane energies in a small chromatic aberration within the broken lightbulb, which you hold up. Choose a creature within range and between green light or red light. On a red light, the target creature must pass a Charisma Saving Throw or have their senses overtaken by a blinding red light, having their maximum walking speed reduced in half.
A green light however grants the creature a bonus to their walking speed equal to half their maximum current speed.

spell.name: Congealed Shot
entries: This bullet features a smooth gelatin congealed within its casing which explodes after hitting a target. When used, you may choose any point within your Marksman Weapon's range to shoot. When the bullet hits a surface, it detonates in the form of a 5-ft large sphere of gelatin.

If this gelatin hits a creature, they must perform a Strength Saving Throw or be pushed in the opposite direction of where they were hit for up to 10 * SL feet, with Large or greater creatures having advantage on this Saving Throw.

After being deployed, any creature within 5-feet of the gelatin may use their bonus action to hop onto the Gelatin, being flung in the air on a long jump for the same distance as if they would be hit in length and half that number, rounded down, of height, or the inverse if they choose to perform a high jump.

spell.name: Conjure Flower Fields

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th level or higher, you throw 2 additional seeds and deal an additional {@dice 2d10} acid damage on an explosion for each slot level above 7th.

You summon throw a bundle of seeds up into the air, having them develop in an explosive manner, quickly becoming a sprout ready to take root in the ground where it falls. As part of casting this spell you may choose any unoccupied space within the spell’s range to have a seed fall upon, for a total of 6 seeds. They quickly take root and bloom into a small patch of flowers of your choice. These flowers, despite retaining a normal appearance, contain a poisonous substance that they release upon feeling the presence of a creature nearby.

Whenever a creature moves into the flowers space or is within a 5-ft. radius of them they must pass a Dexterity saving throw or be caught in the flowers explosion, becoming {@condition Poisoned} for the next minute and suffering {@dice 4d10} acid damage. A creature {@condition Poisoned} in this way feels their whole body become wobblier and softer, as if made as easy to cut as it is to remove a petal from a flower - That creature becomes Vulnerable to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage for as long as they are suffering from this Condition, being able to attempt a Constitution saving throw at the end of their turns to end the Condition early.

entries.name: Duration
entries: Until dispelled.

spell.name: Cosmic Regurgitation
entries: There should be no relent from the force of gravity, as its law will be imposed onto every single being under the sun. You tap into that universal rule, violently flooding a creature with your arcane energy and pulling them. Choose one creature within range, it must pass a Strength Saving Throw or be hoisted up into the air, becoming unable to move.

As part of your action when you cast this spell and its target fails its Saving Throw, you hurl them through the air to any space within 60-feet of yourself. If they would land on the floor, they take {@damage 4d8} bludgeoning damage. If they would land on another creature, the other creature must pass a Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 4d12} bludgeoning damage as well, with the floating target taking the same value of damage.

spell.name: Crown of Metal
entries: You gaze upon a creature within the reach of this spell and have them believe that a disease has overtaken their head, slowly turning it into metal. The target creature must pass a Wisdom Saving throw or be affected by the spell, their perception distorted to feel the pressure of their forehead slowly turning into metal, and the rest of their head soon to follow suit. At the start of each of their turns, the afflicted creature must spend one of their attacks to bang their head against the nearest solid surface, taking {@damage 2d8} bludgeoning damage as they desperately try to free their head from the metallic ringing that will never stop.

If they would deal damage to another creature through a melee attack, they also take {@dice 1d8} damage as their desperate flailing ends up hurting them back. The target may retry the saving throw at the end of each of their turns, being cured on a success.

spell.name: Crown of Penitence

components.m: a diamond worth at least 300 gp, a thorn to be embedded into fingers

entries: "One Sin and Hundreds of Good Deeds awaits humanity's sin." You start chanting in a low voice, your eyes turning into a hazy gray as your gaze remains not on the material around you, but on the spiritual. You gaze into your peers sins and guilts, and may absolve them, even if momentarily to bring forth a moment of respite, for recognizing the wrong doing is the first step toward penitence. As a bonus action on their turns, any creature beside you may speak aloud a sin that they've commited in which they feel guilty about, such as a devout breaking a tenet of their deity or a war veteran declaring their regret for taking the life of an innocent.

For each sin confessed this way, add a +1 to a Penitence Tracker. Creatures may individualy confess up to three sins until the spell ends. After confessing, the creature takes 1 point of piercing damage as a Crown of Thorns manifests around their head.

The Penitence Tracker may not exceed 9 Points unless a Heavy Sin is uttered. For each 3 points in the Penitence Tracker, each creature who has confessed and yourself feel your shoulders get much lighter, granting a cumulative +1 to all your rolls for the spells duration.
Otherwise, upon reaching certain thresholds on the Penitence Tracker, you may perform the actions on the following table by spending your Action. You may only perform any of these once.

entries.caption: Penitence Actions
rows: {@b Penitence Through Pain.} All the confessing creatures take {@damage 3d8} piercing damage as their crown digs into their scalp, a searing yet liberating pain encroaching through their body. Those who would be reduced to below one hit point remain at one hit point instead, and all gain {@dice 5d8} temporary hit points, in addition to resistance to non-magical piercing, bludgeoning and slashing damage.

{@b Bring Forth the Guilty.} You may choose up to three non-confessing creatures within the spells range and ask them to confess a sin of the same weight as your fellows. After responding or not, they must perform a Charisma saving throw or suffer the weight of their sins through a lightning bolt falling through the skies and onto them, dealing {@damage 4d8} lightning damage on a failure, or half on a success. Creatures who have confessed have advantage on this Saving Throw.

{@b Rain Absolution.} A mighty downpour comes to wash away the dread and mistakes of old, offering a moment's respite to the penitent's souls and reminding the unrepentant of their grace. All creatures within the area must pass a Charisma Saving Throw or be buffeted heavily by the rain, taking {@damage 8d8} bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half on a success. Confessers fail the saving throw automatically, yet instead of taking damage are healed by half the amount.

entries: When confessing, a creature may instead of confessing only what weighs upon them, they may confess their heaviest sin, such as being the fault for the death of a city or having betrayed their loved ones in ways they can never go back. The DM has final say if the sin is heavy enough or not, yet sins confessed in this manner are worth 3 Penitence points.

If the Penitence tracker reaches 15 Points with only heavy confessions, you may utter a final sin of your own authorship. Upon doing so, a bright light encompasses the area around the spell, it's duration is reset, all those who confessed are reduced to one hit point and cannot be knocked {@condition Unconscious} until the spell ends, as the hefty weight of the crown on each confesser's head doesn't seem to budge, yet the will to acknowledge past mistakes makes it all the more bearable, the thorns starting to bud in small, red flowers.

spell.name: Curse of Eroding Will
entries: You deliver a mind-shattering curse to another creature, forcing them to pass a Charisma Saving Throw or suffering from their will rapidly eroding in a horrible lapse into dread. On a failure, they suffer a negative modifier to their attack rolls, ability checks and Strength and Wisdom saving throws for each 5-ft. of movement speed they have reduced and 9 {@condition Sinking|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} count.

Additionally, this breach in their resolve causes them to lose 5-ft. of movement speed per each 3 {@condition Sinking|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} count they are suffering from, to a maximum loss of 20-ft. of movement. This negative modifier cannot surpass a -3 either.

spell.name: Curtain Fall

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you may teleport up to 10-ft. further for each slot level above 2nd. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher you have advantage on the {@skill Stealth} check of your next Hide action.

Be it with a flamboyant hand gesture or an eccentric bow, you summon a curtain around you to hide your form as you teleport towards an unnocupied space within 15-ft. of you. As part of casting this spell you may take the Hide action, taking advantage of the sudden vanishing.

spell.name: Dead-Air Sphere
entries: {@i Chronurgy spell.}

You summon a monochromatic sphere around a point you can see within range, encompassing a 30-foot-radius sphere. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature has its perception of time cut out for a brief second, suffers 6 {@condition Tremor|TheUndertomesGeneralRules}, and then suffers a {@variantrule Tremor Burst|TheUndertomesGeneralRules}. On a successful save, it suffers half as much {@condition Tremor|TheUndertomesGeneralRules}, rounded down.

entries.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the {@condition Tremor|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} increases by 2 for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Desperate Struggle
entries: Your pains and woes have been made manifest, making growing tendrils of hardened flesh and blood to pierce back at those who’d dare take pieces of you away. The creature who has damaged you for the reaction spent for casting this spell must pass a Dexterity saving throw or suffer {@dice 7d8} piercing damage, or half that damage on a success. Every hostile creature within 5-ft. of the initial target must pass the same saving throw or suffer half the damage dealt.

Furthermore, this spell deals an additional die of damage equal to the maximum value your hit die that is currently missing from your current hit points, such as a paladin missing 16 hit points dealing an additional {@dice 2d8} piercing damage or a wizard missing 30 hit points dealing an additional {@dice 5d6} piercing damage. This may go to a maximum amount of die equal to your maximum hit die.
You may spend up to two hit die per creature killed by this spell, recovering an amount of hit points equal to the amount rolled.

spell.name: Devour the Moon

components.m: the removed upper teeth of a wolf

entries: You manifest the giant disembodied head of a scar-covered wolf to bite down on a creature. Choose a creature within range, it and all other creatures around 5-feet of it must pass a Dexterity check or take {@damage 4d4} piercing damage on failure, with the creature chosen also taking an additional {@damage 4d4} piercing damage and being {@condition Restrained} for the spells duration, unless the maw is destroyed or you lose concentration. The Wolf's Maw has an AC of 8 and 60 hit points.
It has weakness to silvered weapons and resistence to non-magical piercing, slashing and bludgeoning damage.

spell.name: Disruptive Bullet
entries: Also called thundershot, this bullet doesn't pack much of a punch but manages to disorient a person long enough to be helpful.
