When used, you may choose a target within your Marksman Weapon's range and perform a ranged weapon attack against them, on a hit you deal {@dice SLd4} thunder damage and they suffer a penalty to Concentration checks and to any roll pertaining Interacting with an Object until the end of their next turn, as exceedingly loud ringing in their ears impedes them from doing so. This penalty's value is equal to half your PB times SL.

spell.name: Doombox Aura
entries: You summon an aura of living music in a 30-foot radius around yourself that moves with you. Choose any style of music. At the end of each of your turns, every glass, metal, or crystal object in the aura takes {@damage 4d6} thunder damage.

entries.name: Play It Loud
entries: As a bonus action after casting the spell, you can tune the music to force creatures of your choice in the aura to make a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 4d6} thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

entries.name: Signature Track
entries: Alternatively, the spell deals no damage to objects, and you gain a +2 bonus to Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) and Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) checks and a +3 bonus to Charisma ({@skill Performance}) checks while the music plays.

entries.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When cast using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, Play It Loud deals an additional {@damage 2d6} thunder damage and the bonuses from Signature Track increase by 1 for every two slot levels above 2nd. When cast using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the spell deals double damage to buildings and the listed materials, and a creature that fails its saving throw against Play It Loud is also {@condition Prone||knocked prone}.

spell.name: Echoes of the Void

components.m: an eroded keepsake of your life

entries: You unleash a wave of arcane energy containing every pent-up frustration and broken hope you have had in your life. All creatures of your choice within a 60-ft. radius of yourself must pass a Wisdom saving throw or suffer {@dice 4d8} necrotic damage and become {@condition Frightened} of you for the next minute.

While {@condition Frightened} in this way they are sapped of all their will to live or perform actions, suffering a d4 negative modifier to their rolls. On a success, they take half initial damage and are {@condition Frightened} of you until the end of their next turn, but suffer no additional effects.

Whenever you would deal damage to a creature {@condition Frightened} in this way they suffer an additional {@dice 3d8} necrotic damage and may attempt another Wisdom saving throw, ending the condition early on a success.

spell.name: Exploding Apples

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you create an additional apple for each second slot level above 2nd, such as 4th level, 6th level and 8th level.

You wave your hand around the air as apple seeds float around it, growing into three glowing apples. You then choose to toss the apples at any creature within reach, being able to select any multiple or single target to perform a ranged spell attack roll per apple. On a hit the apples explode into a blast of roots and seeds which cling to the creature, dealing {@dice 2d4} piercing damage and inflicting 1 Immobilized into them.

spell.name: Fae Wedding
entries: A fae contract is nigh unbreakable, and you have managed to have such magic be binding in matrimony as well. Over the course of this ritual you create a contract between two willing creatures you can touch, designating a pair of objects they both must wear in their person or have their connection severed. These objects may be anything that is easily worn, such as a pair of rings or bracelets.
Creatures bound this way receive the following benefits:

items: Neither creature may die as long as the other is alive and not {@condition Unconscious}, and one may instantly stabilize the other through an action while within 5-ft. of their body.
While within 5-ft. of each other they gain a +1 modifier to all rolls.
While further than 30-ft. apart of each other they suffer a -1 negative modifier to all rolls and instantly die if they spend more than a week apart.

entries.name: Duration
entries: Until dispelled or the spell is broken.

spell.name: Fairies' Care

components.m: a sprinkle of pixie dust on ham

entries: You bring forth a cluster of small green faeries that surround a target creature within range, they gently frollick and fly around them, giggling as they heal their wounds. At the start of that creature's turn, it regains {@damage 1d4+1} hit points. If they would regain hit points through any other means while Fairies' Care is active, the cluster of faeries turns on them, ravenously biting away at them before dispersing.
The spell ends early and the creature who was once benefitting from them takes an amount of d8 piercing damage equal to the amount of turns they were healed by Fairies' Care.

spell.name: Fan the Flame
entries: You mystically extend the wing in your hand to become a blazing fan and then beat it, causing a great scorching gale to overtake the area within range. All creatures of your choice must pass a Constitution saving throw or suffer 1 {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} count and then have all failing creature's count of the Condition be summed up and then divided equally amongst them.

spell.name: Fear of God [Cleric Only]
entries: There are times where the only right thing to do is to remind others of their mortality, of how even when simply tapped into, the power of a divinity will tear a soul asunder and spit it out. You teach others the fear of god. As an action, you raise your hand and a finger up in the air, spending an action in subsequent turns to raise another.

At raising your hand, any creature inside this area feels the ground shake violently and perceives the sky turning red, with dark clouds gathering around. For each finger that is raised, a different effect occurs in that round, as described below. You are immune to these effects, and failed saving throws still cause creatures to take half the damage rolled.

entries.caption: Fear of God Table
colLabels: A Plague to Render Faithlessness Into Oblivion
rows: {@b Maelstrom Edict.} The heavy clouds in the sky start plummeting all the area in a heavy tempest. All creatures in the area must pass a Dexterity Saving throw or take {@damage 4d8} bludgeoning damage and have their movement speed reduced by 20 feet until the end of their next turn.

{@b Floods Edict.} From the downpour's waters a mighty whirlpool starts forming below your feet, all creatures within the area must pass a Strength saving throw or take {@damage 8d8} cold damage from the freezing waters plummeting them, also being knocked {@condition Prone} on failure.

{@b Disease Edict.} You cause the waters to turn foul and filled with disease, all creatures within the area must pass a Constitution Saving Throw or suffer from the {@condition Poisoned} condition until healed through a Restoration spell or similar, more powerful means. This ignores immunity, as divine cells slowly corrode the body instead of a normal sickness.

{@b Blazing Edict.} The diseased water suddenly turns gooey and dark like oil, soon bursting in an inferno of white flame. All creatures inside must pass an Intelligence Saving Throw or suffer from the flames finding a home in their eyes, giving them the {@condition Blinded} condition until healed through means like the edict above, also having them take {@damage 6d8} radiant damage.

{@b Edict of Shadow.} The flames vanish in the blink of an eye, yet the shadows they cast remain, quickly scurrying inside any unlocked door, window or other passageway. Any creature within 30-feet of a passageway inside the spells area must pass a Wisdom Saving Throw or be grasped and pierced by shadow hands that induce waking nightmares into their brains, having them take {@damage 6d4} necrotic damage and suffer the effects of {@spell bane|PHB|Bane} until cured by the means above.

{@b Insignificance Edict.} You finish the spell by clasping both hands together in prayer. All corpses within the area explode in white fire, any creature within 10-feet of a corpse must make a Charisma Saving Throw or take {@damage 3d8} psychic damage per corpse that exploded in a 10-feet range of them, as the reminder of their insignificance in the grand scheme of things dawns on them.

entries: After casting this spell, your index finger is burnt in radiant light. You take {@damage 4d12} radiant light as this scars your body, so not even you may forget this lesson of Faith.

spell.name: Ferite Sostenudo

time.condition: taken when a friendly creature within reach would be knocked below one hit point

entries: You concentrate on a single sustained performance, trying to sustain the same notes as long as possible as they take a physical form and cling onto a creature’s skin to make sure they stay up even while being at the brink of their life. While concentrating on this spell one target creature of your choice cannot become {@condition Unconscious} or have their amount of hit points be knocked under one, but if they suffer a cummulative amount of damage equal to their maximum hit points while you are still concentrating on this spell, this spell ends early as the notes holding them together burst open, instantly having you and the protected creature suffer {@dice 6d8} thunder damage and 2 points of {@condition Exhaustion}.

spell.name: First Lightlock
entries: You crush the petal under your thumb to have its remains form a glowing sigil of a petal behind your shoulder, simultaneously creating increasing gashes of concentrated light. You perform a ranged spell attack roll against a target creature within reach, dealing {@damage 2d6} slashing damage on a hit.

Each time you cast this spell, you may use your Action during your next turn to spend a Spell Slot of one level greater to cast this spell at a greater Unlock rank, causing additional effects to trigger as per the following:

entries.name: Unlock II
entries: The second time this spell is cast you perform an additional ranged spell attack roll against the target, dealing {@damage 3d8} piercing damage on a hit. You have advantage on this roll if you hit the first attack.

entries.name: Unlock III
entries: The third time this spell is cast, the slashing damage it deals increases to {@damage 3d6} and the piercing damage it deals increases to {@damage 4d8}.
After using any greater Unlock rank, you may spend it's corresponding Spell Slot Level to cast this spell and make use of it's corresponding effects until the end of your next long rest.

entries.name: Singleton
entries: After causing the effects of Unlock III, you regain one first-level spell slot.

spell.name: First Trumpet
entries: The sound of duty is riveting, awe-inspiring, and hard to manage. As a reaction to when combat starts, you may tap into that pool of inspiration to coat an area with fanfare and the song of trumpets. Choose up to four creatures in the spells range.

You and the chosen creatures gain a +2 to your Initiative modifier and for the duration of the spell have a +1 to hit on the first attack done during your turn. At Higher Levels: For each second spell level spent for this spell, add an additional +1 to your Initiative modifier and a +1 to hit. Ex: Casting this spell at 4th level grants a +3 to Initiative and a +2 to hit.

spell.name: Fleeting Emberblade

components.m: a finger coated in candle wax

entries: You create a bright flaming blade that extends from your fingers. Make a melee spell attack against a creature within range. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d8} fire damage and suffers 1 {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} count.
The spell's damage and Burn increase when you reach 5th level ({@damage 2d8}, 3 Burn), 11th level ({@damage 3d8}, 4 Burn), and 17th level ({@damage 4d8}, 5 Burn).

spell.name: Forest Purifying Light

components.m: The torn wing of a bird.

entries: Nothing will dare harm you, not when armageddon is brought upon their house. When you cast this spell, choose a creature to be engulfed by encroaching light, which makes shadows it creates move as if they were alive. The target must pass a Wisdom Saving Throw or take {@damage 12d8} radiant damage and suffer a level of Exhaustion, as the light exhonerates them of their will to live.

If the target passes this Saving Throw, they instead take half damage and automatically pass any further Saving Throws against this spell for the next day. If this damage kills a creature, you may choose an additional creature to become a target, forcing them to attempt the same Wisdom Saving Throw, taking a further {@damage 2d8} radiant damage per previously killed target. This spell may be reused only 2 times per turn.
At Higher Levels: : If this spell was cast using a 9th level spell slot, it deals an additional {@damage 2d8} radiant damage and may be reused 2 more times.

spell.name: Frontliner's Baton March

components.m: a glass shard from a broken picture holder

entries: You conjure forth a plume of reddish smoke that lingers on the feet of your target, spreading outwards with movement and reinvigorating spirits as if it were a flare to focus aim onto a single victorious future. The target gains an additional 15-ft. of movement speed until the end of their next turn. At the start of their turn they gain 2 Poise count and gain an additional 2 count for each friendly creature they first enter within 5-ft. of until the end of their turn. Creatures passed by this way gain an amount of Poise count at the end of the runner's turn equal to 2 + the amount of creatures passed by.

spell.name: Frozen Cries

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, you deal an additional d8 cold damage and inflict 1 more {@condition Sinking|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} Count for each slot level above 5th.

Those who are left behind are often the ones who try the hardest to catch up, and it is through that sentiment that you bellow out a scream to reach those that you once thought unreachable. When you cast this spell, your turn instantly ends and you gain a second turn at Initiative count 1. When your additional turn begins, you instantly spend your Action to finish casting this spell, manifesting a mask around your head and neck resembling that of a mad fowl, then screaming at the top of your lungs. All hostile creatures within 60-ft. of you must pass a Charisma Saving Throw or suffer {@dice 6d8} cold damage and 8 {@condition Sinking|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} Count, or half that damage and count on a success.
If you suffer damage between these two turns, the damage dealt by this Saving Throw increases by {@dice 4d8} and inflicts an additional 4 {@condition Sinking|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} Count.

spell.name: Gift of an Broken Heart
entries: Sometimes you just know when someone feigns niceness, or when to call it quits with the whole friends thing, just put an end to it. You raise an open palm towards a creature you can see within reach, a beating, wrapped cartoon heart appearing over it. The creature must pass a Charisma saving throw or be forced to accept the gift.

A creature who accepted the gift has the heart you made sewn into their skin, above their own, being able to be seen even through their clothes as if there were nothing there. It remains for up to three turns, its beat becoming faster and faster with each passing turn. On the start of the creatures first turn, it is disoriented by a deep despair settling into their heart, suffering a -1 to all rolls.

On the start of their second turn, this despair starts wrapping its fingers across their heart, it suffering then a -2 to all rolls and having its movement speed halved. On the start of their third turn, they must attempt a Charisma saving throw once more at disadvantage. On a failure, their heart breaks, taking {@damage 7d10} piercing damage, and suffering a -3 to all rolls for the next minute, as they are overcome with the weight of oblivion settling onto their chest.
At Higher Levels: When this spell is cast at a level higher than 4th, heartbreak deals {@dice 1d10} additional damage per spell slot cast above 4th.

spell.name: Golden Surveillance
entries: Being subtle is a luxury, one for those who don't fear being feared themselves. You summon hundreds of floating golden eyes that clump towards the top of buildings and corners, they are tiny creatures with 4 hit points and an AC of 12, their stealth modifier is +4. These eyes will instinctively attempt to hide themselves as best they can while settling to cover the whole area of the spell, yet are not {@condition Invisible||invisible} and any other creature may perceive them with a succesful {@skill Perception} check against them.

As a bonus action, you may tap into the web of arcana to peer through the eyes, also hearing anything within 60-feet of them. While you do this, you are considered {@condition Blinded||blinded} and {@condition Deafened||deafened} to your current surroundings, but gain a +3 modifier to {@skill Perception} and {@skill Investigation} checks to survey the area or look for something inside it. At Higher Levels: If this spell is cast using a 9th level spell slot, its range increases by 300 feet.

spell.name: Greetings from Broken Bone
entries: Great things take time and patience, such as saying hello to a person for the first time, to make it memorable. You kneel in preparation, channeling a necrotic power to the palm of your hands. When you cast this spell, you cannot move away from the space you're in until the start of your next turn.

Choose a direction within 5-feet of you, of where a 10-feet wide and 30-feet long line will form. At the start of your next turn, the spell goes off with a great stream of broken, sharpened bones shooting foward, all creatures within the lines area must pass a Dexterity Saving Throw or suffer {@damage 8d10} necrotic damage plus {@damage 4d4} piercing damage, or half on a success. Additionally, they can't recover lost hit points until the end of your next turn.

At Higher Levels:This spells damage increases by {@damage 1d10} necrotic damage and {@damage 1d4} piercing damage when cast at 6th level, and proportionaly increases by additional die on each level above 6th.

spell.name: Heart-Breaking Smite
entries: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before this spell ends, the weapon's figure distorts to seem cracked and its material slowly melting. The attack deals an additional {@damage 2d6} cold damage to the target and inflicts half the damage dealt ( rounded down. ) as counts of {@condition Sinking|TheUndertomesGeneralRules}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the extra damage increases by {@damage 1d6} for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Heartbreaking One

components.m: A tear-stained page filled with stories

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you can target an additional creature for each spell slot level higher than the original used.

You sing or recount an incredibly devastating tale that has become entrenched in your mind to a creature within 30 feet of you. They must roll a Wisdom saving throw, on a failure, they become afflicted with Madness and must roll on the Short-Term Madness table. If they succeed, they suffer 3 counts of {@condition Sinking|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} instead.

spell.name: Hiding Bandages

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you may target an additional creature within reach for each level above 2nd. You may also choose an additional Condition to nullify per second spell slot spent above 4th, such as 4th, 6th and 8th level spell slots.

You fling out the ribbon toward a willing creature within reach, having it latch onto their back and have their body be covered in red laces which hide away their impurities and wounds. You may choose to nullify the effects of one of the Conditions the target is suffering from for the spell’s duration.

spell.name: Hollow Words
entries: Even words can haunt a creature to their core. You choose a creature within range to suffer a psychic onslaught. They must pass a Wisdom Saving Throw or take {@damage 2d8} psychic damage and suffer from the Panicked condition, or just take half damage on a success.
Higher Levels: You may choose an additional target for this spell when its cast on every second level above 2nd, such as having two targets at 4th.

spell.name: Human Taming
entries: You concentrate a great amount of dense spore dust in your palm and blow it toward a creature within reach, forcing them to pass a Constitution saving throw or be transformed into a Beast or Plant of your choice, provided that you have seen that specific creature before and that the target’s Level or CR is equal to or lower to the creature chosen.

The target retains their memories and cognition, but if their Intelligence score is greater than the chosen Beast or Plant’s, it becomes the chosen Beast or Plant’s Intelligence score plus the target’s previous Intelligence modifier. The target also keeps the ability to understand any language they spoke before, but cannot speak if the creature they become cannot as well This spell’s effects can only be reversed through a {@spell Greater Restoration} or greater spell or through casting this spell on the target again while choosing to simply revert them back to their original form. An anti-magic zone or any likewise magic nullifying zone does not nullify this spell’s effects.

spell.name: Invoke Giant Beanstalks
entries: You raise a hand towards a point you can see within reach, causing a gigantic beanstalk to jut out of the ground violently fast. This Beanstalk has a radius of 15-ft. and raises up to 120- ft. into the air, with any unwilling creature within the area being forced to pass a Dexterity saving throw or be carried to the top, or being moved to the closest safe unnocupied space on a success.

This Beanstalk has 80 hit points and counts as full cover to any creature standing beside it, also having an AC of 15, immunity to all Conditions except {@condition Poisoned} and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, thunder, lightning, and radiant damage, but vulnerability to fire and acid damage.

While {@condition Poisoned} the Beanstalk loses 15 hit points at the end of your turns, and when destroyed it collapses ontop of creatures in the opposing side, forcing all creatures within a line as wide and long as the Beanstalk to attempt a Dexterity Saving Throw or be crushed under stalk, being knocked {@condition Prone} on a failure and suffering {@dice 8d10} bludgeoning damage, or being moved to the nearest safe unnocupied space on a success.
You may also spend an Action on your next turns to touch the Beanstalk and detach it to fall into any direction of your choice.

entries.name: Duration
entries: Until cut or Dispelled.

spell.name: Iron-Hearted Curse

components.m: A piece of metal that is beaten and mishapen

entries: You clasp your hands together, having mana flow through them until the piece of metal melds into nothing. You then choose a creature within reach of whom molten metal falls upon, forcing them to pass a Wisdom saving throw or suffer the curse, or take {@dice 3d6} fire damage on a success.

A creature suffering from the Iron-Hearted Curse becomes unable to feel their feelings properly, having most of them dulled or seemingly non-existant at all. They gain immunity from being {@condition Frightened} or {@condition Charmed}, but cannot Charm other creatures or benefit from any sort of Bard spell. They also suffer Disadvantage on all Charisma skill checks and when it would suffer psychic damage they suffer an additional die equal to the original source and take 2 {@condition Tremor|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} count, as the still-beating heart in their chest writhes in pain of being denied to exist as it should.
This curse can only be removed through a {@spell Remove Curse} spell or greater.

entries.name: Duration
entries: Until dispelled.

spell.name: Land of Smiles
entries: Sickness and disease come in many forms, sometimes that form is elation. Choose a point within range, a viscous black bud of a plant appears in that spot, quickly bursting into dark fluid that covers a 15-foot radius around it, turning the area into difficult terrain and forcing any creatures within to pass a Charisma Saving throw or have their movement speed halved until they start their turn outside the difficult terrain as their thoughts are assaulted by an eery elation.

spell.name: Landshark Lunge
entries: You have learned how to mold earth in a frightening manner, yet to do so, you must use your entire body. As part of your action when you cast this spell, you dive headfirst into the ground as if it were a liquid substance, until the end of your turn you gain a Burrowing speed equal to your walking speed. On the end of your turn, you are flung back to the surface on the nearest empty 5-foot space, when you do this, you may cause a crash of sharp rocks to appear up alongside you, resembling the sharp teeth of a shark's maw.

Any creatures within a 10-feet radius of that space must pass a Dexterity Saving Throw or take {@damage 2d10} piercing damage. At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 1d10} for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Lead Bullet
entries: Simple, effective. This bullet is made of solid lead, containing only a handful of poisons and acids applied. When used, you make a ranged weapon attack with your Marksman Weapon. On hit, in addition to its normal damage inflicted, the target must pass a Constitution Saving Throw or suffer from the {@condition Poisoned} Condition for the next minute, repeating this Constitution Saving Throw at the end of their turns. On the first failure of this Saving Throw and on subsequent Saving Throws at the end of their turn, regardless of their outcome, the {@condition Poisoned} creature also suffers {@dice SLd8|SL d8} poison damage. Creatures immune to poison damage instead treat this damage as if they only had resistance.

spell.name: Magic Bullet Fire

components.m: a piece of ammunition kissed by a devil

entries: You insert a piece of ranged ammunition into a ranged weapon, infusing it with pure, violent magic through a magic circle that appears at the barrel or point of your weapon. You then shoot in a direction of your choice, covering a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long line as the bullet explodes in a nearly blinding flash, never truly missing its target. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 1d10} force damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

entries.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by {@damage 1d10} for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Make Fearless
entries: You let out a wave of magic to wash over your allies, emboldening them to keep fighting the good fight no matter what. Choose up to five friendly creatures including yourself within the spells range, these creatures gain a +1 bonus to hit and to their Armor Class for the next three rounds, also being granted 15 temporary hit points. At Higher Levels: The value of the bonuses to hit and to AC are increased by a further +1 for each third level above 3rd, such as 6th and 9th level.
The amount of temporary hit points gained also increases by 5.

spell.name: Mark of the Witness

components.m: A stone eye to crush between your fingers

entries: You cause a bright flash around you, drawing the attention of creatures to you and nothing else as your body starts bearing runes and symbols to stare back at however many peer back into you. When you cast this spell, all creatures of your choice within reach must pass a Wisdom saving throw or have their gaze and attention fully stuck on you, making them be considered {@condition Blinded} and {@condition Deafened} against any creature that isn’t you, but having Advantage on any attacks against you for the spell’s duration. The runes also boost your speed, an euphoric adrenalin rush flowing through your veins as you’re stared at, granting a +1 bonus modifier to your Armor Class per creature affected by this spell, to a maximum modifier of +5.

For the duration, afflicted creatures may choose to retry their Wisdom saving throw at the end of their turn. Any creature who passed this saving throw automatically succeeds any subsequent saving throw caused by this spell for the next hour.

spell.name: Mauling Skull

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the piercing damage increases by {@dice 1d8} and necrotic damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each slot level above 2nd. It also generates 1 additional {@condition Poise|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} count for each slot level above 2nd.

You beckon forth the vertebral spine and skull of a giant skeleton formed from thick black mist, having it whip out to target another creature within reach and sink it’s teeth into that poor soul. You gain 3 {@condition Poise|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} and then perform a ranged spell attack against a creature within reach, dealing {@dice 2d8} piercing damage and an additional {@dice 3d6} necrotic damage if you trigger a Posture Critical with this spell. Furthermore, if you trigger a Posture Critical with this spell the Critical’s damage is necrotic and the target creature gains 2 {@condition Poise|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} count.

spell.name: Metalboom
entries: You touch a metallic orb to infuse it with entropic energy and turn it into a grenade. As part of casting this spell you toss it to a point within reach, forcing all targets within reach to pass a Dexterity Saving Throw or suffer {@dice 3d6} bludgeoning damage and 2 {@condition Tremor|TheUndertomesGeneralRules}, or half on a success. When you toss the orb you may also choose to have it inflict {@variantrule Tremor Burst|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} after all other effects have resolved.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: For each 2 Spell Slot Levels spent above 2nd, the damage of this spell increases by {@dice 2d6} and it inflicts an additional {@condition Tremor|TheUndertomesGeneralRules}.

spell.name: Metronome Modal
entries: {@i Chronurgy spell.}

You summon a magic circle with a 30-foot radius centered on a point of your choice within range. A clock hand pierces the ground at its center, shifting from side to side on initiative count 20. Starting with the turn the spell is cast, the metronome alternates from Odd to Even, producing the following effects for every creature within the circle:

entries.name: Tick (Odd Turns)
entries: All damage taken is reduced by {@dice 2d4} after it is rolled.

entries.name: Tock (Even Turns)
entries: All damage dealt increases by {@damage 1d6} bludgeoning damage, and each creature inflicts 1 {@condition Tremor|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} on a hit.

Once per turn while the spell is active, when a creature hits another creature within the circle, you can use your reaction to cause the target to suffer a {@variantrule Tremor Burst|TheUndertomesGeneralRules}.

entries.name: At Higher Levels
entries: For every two spell slot levels above 4th, creatures within the circle inflict 1 additional {@condition Tremor|TheUndertomesGeneralRules}, and the circle's radius increases by 10 feet.

spell.name: Mind Lasher

components.m: a chain wrapped around your hand

entries: You produce a heavy spectral chain buzzing with purple energy. Make a melee spell attack against a target within range. On a hit, it takes {@damage 1d8} + your spellcasting ability modifier in psychic damage.
The damage increases by {@damage 1d8} and the range changes when you reach 5th level ({@damage 2d8}, 20 feet), 11th level ({@damage 3d8}, 25 feet), and 17th level ({@damage 4d8}, 30 feet).

entries.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When cast using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the target is covered in gashes that deal the same number of damage dice it took from the spell, plus an additional {@damage 2d8} psychic damage for every two slot levels above 2nd.

spell.name: Mutual Exsanguination

components.m: The blood of your own body

entries: You either deliver a nasty cut to one of your palms that soon closes as blood seeps out to the floor, or you simply sacrifice your blood magically to summon two gangly pale arms around you, reaching around to grasp at one creature of your choice within range. When you cast this spell, you take an amout of your hit die in slashing damage equal to the level you cast it on, and the target creature must pass a Constitution Saving Throw or take double the amount of die in slashing damage, as slices and gashes start being formed as the hands hold them, then crumbling to dust in the end of the spell. The amount of Hit Die spendable at once is equal to the spell slot level this spell is cast on.
At Higher Levels: For every second spell slot level spent above 2nd level, starting at 4th, you may choose an additional target for this spell.

spell.name: Obsession
entries: You whisper a short string of words into another neutral or friendly creatures ear, often disguised within a phrase or a question and laden with arcane energy. This creature must pass a Charisma Saving throw or be enchanted to become fully obsessed with the main subject of what you said, such as an object, a topic or a person, this becoming their hyperfixation or object of desire for the duration of the spell. A creature enchanted like this will act upon their obsession in increasing levels, on the first five days they may, depending on their personality, have fully researched a topic without having nearly enough sleep, or even stalked the person deemed as their desire, yet they will become desperate and anxious on the sixth and seventh days if they do not acquire their object of desire or make a discovery within the topic of their knowledge.

During these last days, they become hostile to any creatures that might go against their will. In addition, if they have a chance before the sixth day to acquire their object of desire in any manner, they must pass a Charisma Saving Throw or immediately become more deranged, trying their hardest to obtain it earlier.

spell.name: Orb of Balance

components.m: a rock carved into an infinite spiral

entries: Everything as its place in the grand scheme of thing, and for a moment you can condense both positive and negative energy in a sphere to ordain anothers place, or misplacement for that fact. Choose a creature within range, as the sphere zips around the battlefield quickly shifting from place to place until it crashes onto the target creature. It must pass a Wisdom Saving Throw or suffer {@damage 4d6} necrotic damage plus {@damage 3d8} radiant damage, or half on a success.

In addition, on a failure, the energies within the creatures body become mismatched. The next time the creature would be healed, roll {@dice 1d4}. On a result of 2-3, the creature is healed like usual, on a 1 it receives no healing at all, and on 4 it heals by double what it would be.

On the next time the creature would take damage, roll {@dice 1d4}, following the same order as healing, with the difference that it either takes no damage, normal damage or double damage depending on the roll instead of being healed.

spell.name: Paint it Golden

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you inflict an additional count of Golden Sheen for each second slot level above 3rd, such as 5th level, 7th level and 9th level.

You hold the fruit high above your head, a golden sheen manifesting around it before it vanishes as if it’s skin was peeling off. That golden sheen then appears in a spiral pattern over the skin of a target creature within reach, who may pass a Wisdom Saving Throw if unwilling to endure the spell’s effects, suffering nothing on a success. Otherwise, they gain 3 Golden Sheen count. While with Golden Sheen , that creature recovers {@dice 1d8+2} hit points at the end of their turns, but loses one count whenever they are hit by an attack.

Upon the last count of Golden Sheen being removed, the patterns on the creature’s skin constrict and burst into vermin and larvae, inflicting them with double the initial counts of Golden Sheen ‘s in Rotting Flesh count. While suffering Rotting Flesh , the creature suffers half the count’s worth of d8 acid damage whenever they suffer damage, rounded down. After suffering this damage, they lose two counts of the Condition.

spell.name: Paradisiac Rapture
entries: Have you ever wondered what would happen if you crushed the will of a creature from the inside out? Choose a creature that you can see within range, it takes {@damage 4d8} radiant damage and must make a Charisma ssaving throw. On a failed save, the creature's Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma scores become 1, as its mind is fully shattered.

The creature can't cast spells, activate magic items, understand language, or communicate in any intelligible way, and even its instincts become dulled, only retaining basic desires such as wanting to eat or sleep. The creature can, however, identify its friends, follow them, and even protect them. When casting this spell, you may also impose a specific goal for the now brainless creature, in which they will do the best they can to pursue such a goal.

On the case of no goal being given, they are filled with an imeasurable void, taking one point of exhaustion every day at midnight as their mind degrades in its search for any purpose. The spell can only be ended by heal or wish.

spell.name: Perfected Sanctuary
entries: You ward a number of creatures against harm and helping them get back to their feet. A 15-ft. dome of light forms around a point of your choice within range, protecting all willing creatures within and forcing any unwilling one to pass a Wisdom saving throw or be moved out to the nearest unoccupied space. Until the spell ends, any creature who targets a creature within the warded area with an attack or a harmful spell must first make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must choose a new target or lose the attack or spell. This spell protects the warded creatures from area effects, such as the explosion of a {@spell fireball}.
Warded creatures benefit from your Spell Attack modifier to Constitution and Wisdom saving throws and are healed by {@dice 2d8+2} hit points at the start of your turn for the duration of this spell.
If the warded creature makes an attack, casts a spell that affects an enemy, or deals damage to another creature, this spell ends.

spell.name: Pixie Finders

components.m: Three pairs of wings plucked from a fly

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the target suffers an additional {@dice 3d4} piercing damage on a pixie attack for each second slot level above 5th.

You summon a bundle of tiny blood-thirsty pixies that will seek out a target within reach that you describe to track and maim them upon your beck and call. The pixies instantly are aware of the creature as long as you have seen them before and move toward them at a pace of 160-ft. per minute, becoming {@condition Invisible} to all creatures other than you and the target upon setting out to do their task.
Upon finding the target they perform one action of your choice as per the following:

items: The pixies attempt to bite into and devour the target whole, forcing them to pass a Dexterity saving throw or suffer {@dice 12d4} piercing damage, or half on a success.

The pixies attempt to knock out the target with a sleeping dust, forcing them to pass a Constitution saving throw or have them become {@condition Unconscious}. You may then choose to have the pixies make the target {@condition Invisible} for as long as they hold them and tell them to bring the {@condition unconscious} body to a safe empty space within 5-ft. of you.
The pixies deliver a message or item that could be held within your two hands to the target..

entries: If the target is not aware of the pixies, they must attempt their saving throw at disadvantage. The pixies have a bonus modifier to {@skill Stealth} equal to the spell slot level spent for casting this spell. The pixies vanish after completing their task and they attempt to take the safest, quickest route toward their objectives.

spell.name: Prayer of Wholeness

components.m: A holy symbol of a deity

entries: A little trust in your deity goes far, as long as they respond. When you cast this spell choose up to three creatures within range to be healed by {@damage 8d8+8} hit points and then roll a d100, on a result below 20 nothing happens, between 21-40 the targets are healed by half that amount, between 41-80 the targets are healed by the normal result and above 81 they are healed by double the hit points that would be restored.

spell.name: Pyre of Prophecy
entries: Through whispers of shattered texts and precognition of old you cause a burning pyre to burst out from an unnocupied 10-ft. by 10-ft. space within reach, rising to stand tall and cause life to burn bright.

This Pyre is a large object that has an AC of 17, Resistance to Fire and Radiant damage and is Vulnerable to cold damage. It does not benefit from this Resistance toward suffering {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} damage.

The Pyre demands the extinguishment of all around it, constantly emanating scorching air that causes all creatures within 30-ft. of it to suffer 2 {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} at the end of their turns. At the start of a creatures turn they must pass a Wisdom saving throw or suffer 6 {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} count if they are inside this area.

Furthermore, this Pyre makes burns inside its reach feel like one is being pressed against hell itself, increasing {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} damage to {@dice d8|d8s} instead of {@dice d4|d4s} and {@condition Tremor - Scorch|TheUndertomesGeneralRules}'s end of turn damage to {@dice d8|d8s} as well. The Condition's burst damage becomes {@dice d10|d10s} instead of {@dice d6|d6s}.

At the end of your turns, the Pyre gains 2 {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} count per creature inside it's area, to a minimum of 2, and suffers the Condition's damage at the start of your subsequent turns.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, you may select an additional target for each slot level above 5th.

spell.name: Rattling Smite

components.m: a scrap of paper with a symbol that you can peer into and see yourself

entries: You start channelling your magic into your weapons to have it shake and build up a horrible vibration. The next target creature you hit with a melee weapon attack suffers {@damage 1d8} additional thunder damage and three {@condition Tremor|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} count.

spell.name: Ribbonwreathe

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, you target one additional creature per second spell level used above 4th.

With a clap of your hands you make a spool of red ribbons spool unto themselves, compacting until they are gone. You then point to a creature you can see within reach, having the ribbons reappear behind their head and forcing the target to pass a Dexterity Saving Throw or become silenced for the spell’s duration.

A silenced creature cannot speak, use verbal components to cast spells and is also silenced psychically from the spell’s red binds, making them unable to speak telepathically or use psionic energy. Furthermore, for the duration the target has disadvantage on Charisma saving throws and skill checks.

These Ribbons last until the duration is over or until destroyed. They have an AC of 10 and an amount of hit die equal to 15 times the Spell Slot Level used to cast this spell, also having Resistance to non-magical damage and Vulnerability to slashing damage.

spell.name: Rune of Lightbreak

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for each slot level above 5th.

You crush the chalk under a bloody palm to infuse it with your own life, then drawing a rune on the ground that expands to cover a 30-ft radius of where it was initially placed. It symbolizes protection at a desperate moment, activating only upon sensing the presence of those who truly require aid. Any creature who is below 25% of their maximum hit points, rounded down, may spend their Action to clap their hands above the rune and activate it, causing a magical gleam to cover all creatures friendly to them and protect them from a massive explosion which forces all hostile creatures to the original clapping one to pass a Constitution Saving Throw, suffering {@dice 10d8} radiant damage and become {@condition Blinded} until the end of their next turn on a failed save, or half on a success.

When you write the rune, you may choose to sacrifice your own blood to better guarantee you will be the one activating it, suffering an amount of d8 necrotic damage that cannot be reduced by any means equal to the spell slot’s level that was used to cast this spell.

spell.name: Salvation Smite
entries: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before this spell ends, the weapon burns like a lit lamp. The attack deals an extra {@damage 2d6} radiant damage to the target, and a further {@dice 2d6} if they are below half their maximum hit points. This attack cannot be non-lethal and after killing a creature, they cannot be revived by means below a {@spell true resurrection|PHB|True Ressurection} or Wish spells, as their soul is viciously severed from the body.
At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the extra damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Searing Birdcage

components.m: The burnt feather of a goose

entries: You invoke the spirit of a flaming goose that manifests above a target creature within reach and have it then judge their sins. The creature must pass a Wisdom saving throw or suffer {@damage 4d4} fire damage and 4 {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} count.
If the creature has committed any of the following since the start of their last turn, they suffer additional effects upon failing this saving throw:

items: Killed or knocked another creature {@condition Unconscious}.
Cast a spell by spending a spell slot.
Spoke ill or disrespected the core beliefs of a non-Evil aligned deity.

entries: Upon committing any of these sins, the creature suffers {@damage 4d12} fire damage instead as a cage of searing feathers comes to bind them. They also suffer 8 {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} count instead, have their movement speed reduced to 0-ft. and a -3 negative modifier to Dexterity saving throws until the end of their next turn.
If they have committed two or more of these sins, they have Disadvantage on the saving throw.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, you may select an additional target for each slot level above 5th.

spell.name: Sense Quarry

components.m: a slip of paper wishing for peace

entries: You press your hands together and allow the slip of paper to be burnt, with its ashes forming a wave that washes around you, highlighting the silhouette of any creature within range that is actively fighting or harbours immediate hostile intent toward another creature.
You can discern what or who a creature is if you are familiar with their general shape but may not determine the target of their hostility.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the range increases by 100-ft. for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Shakewave
entries: You send out a magnetic shockwave that covers a 30-ft radius around you, forcing any hostile creature within to attempt a Constitution Saving Throw or be knocked {@condition Prone} and suffer 4 {@condition Tremor|TheUndertomesGeneralRules}, or only take half the stacks on a success.

spell.name: Shattering Smite
entries: The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack during the spell's duration, your weapon is enveloped by your very own aura, causing it to ripple against any surface - creating cracks and fissures with ease. On your next hit you deal an additional {@damage 2d4} thunder damage and 2 {@condition Rupture|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} counts.

entries.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the thunder damage dealt by the attack increases by {@dice 1d4} and you deal an additional count of {@condition Rupture|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Shock Bubbles
entries: You conjure three spheres of pure vibrating energy that bend and break the shape of space around them.

You perform three ranged attacks against one target creature within range, or divide each attack towards different targets. On a hit, the target creature suffers three {@condition Tremor|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} counts and takes {@damage 2d6} thunder damage. If three spheres hit the same target, it suffers from {@variantrule Tremor Burst|TheUndertomesGeneralRules}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you create an additional Sphere for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Shrapnel Shot
entries: Various steel pellets are found within this bullet's shell, having a second ignition trigger after hitting a target and exploding to expand its field of effect. When used, you may choose a point within your Marksman Weapon's range, all creatures within a 5 * SL radius of the point must pass a Dexterity Saving Throw or suffer SL die of damage plus your Charisma Modifier, with the type of die and damage matches the Marksman Weapon's. On a success, creatures take half the damage rolled

spell.name: Shrouded Hand
entries: You summon a life-draining hand to lash out at a creature within reach, performing a spell attack roll against them. On a hit you deal {@dice 1d6} necrotic damage and an additional {@dice 1d6} necrotic damage if the target is below half their maximum hit points.
You may change this cantrip's damage type to become radiant against Undead creatures.
This spell’s damage die increases by {@dice 1d6} each when you reach 5th level ({@dice 2d6}), 11th level ({@dice 3d6}), and 17th level ({@dice 4d6}).

spell.name: Sickening Sludge
entries: You invoke a gangrenous stream of black liquid to be spewed in a 15-feet long long, 15-feet wide cone starting from any point of your choice within reach. Any creatures in that area must pass a Dexterity Saving throw or be covered in the dark liquid. On a failure, the afflicted creatures suffer {@damage 3d8} acid damage at the beginning of their turns and suffer a -2 modifier to their Intelligence and Wisdom saving throws, alongside a -3 penalty to Charisma checks and Saving Throws.
This effect lasts until concentration is broken, the spell is dismissed or the afflicted creature coats their body in water.

spell.name: Skim Wounds

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 1d12} and they suffer an additional count of {@condition Bleed|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} for each slot level above 2nd.

You transform your right arm into a long, sharp and green blade. Make a melee attack against one creature within 5 feet of you. If it hits, you deal {@dice 2d12} piercing damage and the creature suffers 2 counts of Bleed. Until the start of your next turn, any creature has disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) ability checks made to stop the Bleeding of target creature.

entries.name: Duration
entries: Until destroyed or until this spell is cast by you again.

spell.name: Skinwalking
entries: You carve out the brain and heart of a body of a creature whose size is equal to yours and that is at most 10 days old and grind them to a fine paste used to form a magic circle around the remains, which over the course of the ritual of casting this spell start floating and melding into your own body. For the duration of this spell, you look exactly like what the creature looked in life, choosing when you first cast this spell if you wish to have it be as it were when the creature first died or looking pristine. Either way, any damage taken afterward does not heal, like a cut on the skin not healing over time. You still recover hit points as usual.

You become indistinguishable from the creature both in looks and voice, perfectly assimilating any mannerisms that person had and learning the memory of the past 24 hours of this creatures life. You may choose to use what Charisma score they had in life instead of yours. Creatures instantly fail to pass {@skill Insight} checks to discern if you aren’t the real person unless they already know of this spell and your Charisma skill checks against them have Advantage. Whenever you’d be questioned something about the creatures memories, you may attempt an Intelligence check against a DC set by the DM, having the corpse whisper vague recollections of events into your ears on a success. Magic detection spells do not work to detect this spell, instead only being detected by the effects of the Detect Poison and Disease spell, which recognizes your fake skin as a toxic substance.

When this spell ends, the false skin becomes like a second layer upon your own expanding body, which reverts to its original proportions and might cause the ol dskin to burst and explode away from you. If your size changes while this spell is active, the spell ends.

entries.name: Duration
entries: Until you end this spell or this is dispelled.

spell.name: Slimey Henchman
entries: You create an adorable, brainless Small ooze that carries and deploys items at your command until the spell ends. The ooze springs out of a puddle you summon in an unoccupied space on the ground within range. It has AC 12, 40 hit points, and a Strength of 8, and it can’t attack. If it drops to 0 hit points, the spell ends and it drops all its contents on the space it was standing.

Once on each of your turns as a bonus action, you can mentally command the servant to move up to 15 feet and either give another creature an item stored inside it or put down a Deployable Tool. The servant may be linked to a container such as a chest, satchel or Bag of Holding during the casting of this spell, being able to teleport any contents of that container into it’s body if able or transporting any item in its body back to the container. If linked to a container, all items contained inside it are teleported back into the container when the spell ends or when it dies. If you link the ooze to another container while it is already linked, it forgets its previous connections and cannot access that container until linked again.
If you command the ooze to move more than 60 feet away from you, the spell ends.

spell.name: Smite of All the Might
entries: The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack during this spell’s duration, your weapon crackles and nearly breaks from an overflow of energy that harms even you, The attack deals an extra {@dice 7d8} radiant damage to the target, but you take that same amount of damage instantly from the sheer force.

spell.name: Smite of Nihilation
entries: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before this spell ends, your weapon nearly shatters under your grasp as it is over-saturated in an energy destined to equalize all things in the end, and the attack deals an extra {@dice 5d10} necrotic damage to the target. This necrotic damage counts as if it were radiant damage when targetting Undead or Fiends. When a creature suffers necrotic damage in this way, their maximum hit points are also reduced by that value for the next hour as their body is left with an open wound covered in a dark void which eats all light, seeming only like a black hole on their skin.

If a creature is knocked {@condition Unconscious} from this smite, their hit point total is reduced permanently by that value, only being restored through a {@spell Greater Restoration} spell or greater.

spell.name: Sorrowful Exhale

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you gain 1 more {@condition Poise|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} Count for each slot level above 4th and may end effects of enchantment spells of one spell slot level below the one this spell is being cast on, such as being able to end 4th level spells when cast with a 5th level spell slot.

You empty your mind and draw in your breath, wrapping your regrets and sorrows into a tight mass to be washed away with a calm exhale, sending you into a state of focus and lightweightedness. When you cast this spell you instantly end the {@condition Frightened} condition, {@condition Charmed} condition and any effects of any enchantment spells of 3rd level or lesser affecting you, then gaining 6 {@condition Poise|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} count. For the duration of this spell your treshhold for performing a Posture Critical is reduced by one ( Such as triggering it on a roll of 19-20 if you have no {@condition Poise|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} count. ) and you deal an additional {@dice 2d6} damage die when you trigger a Posture Critical.

spell.name: Sorrowful Wail

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 1d4}, you inflict additional 1 {@condition Sinking|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} count and this spell’s reach increases by 5-ft for each slot level above 2nd.

You bellow out a sorrowful wail from the depths of your soul, it’s sound waves echoing with raw arcane energy that cling to anyone within your path. All hostile creatures within a 30-ft radius of you must pass a Charisma Saving Throw or suffer {@dice 4d4} psychic damage and 3 {@condition Sinking|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} count, or half that damage and count on a success, rounded down.

spell.name: Sound of Repudiation
entries: You vocalize a melodious tone that ascends into the air as a light that manifests from your lips. Up to three creatures of your choice that are not {@condition Deafened|PHB} within this spell's range must pass a Constitution saving throw or have that note repeated a thousand times inside of their head, overlaid as if a tower of sound were crashing over them.

On a failure, they suffer {@dice 2d6} psychic damage and are rendered unable to form coherent words for the next minute, consequentially being unable to perform verbal components for spellcasting or use voice-activated features. They may re-attempt this saving throw at the end of their subsequent turns, ending the effect early on a success.

On a success or after the effect of a failure passes, they may still only speak in whispers or in whispered shouts for the next ten minutes, as the worlds weigh their mind too much to be able to speak clearly without risking their own vocalization reverberating through their skull in a horrible headache.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 2d4} and you may choose an additional target for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Spread Lean Wings
entries: Even the earth must take to the air at times, all to reach its very own garden of Eden. You crush the bramble between your fingers, its thorny length becoming much larger, covering both of your hands in wings that quickly extend outward in an explosion of spikes. All creatures within a 15-feet radius of yourself must pass a Dexterity Saving Throw or take {@damage 5d8} piercing damage and suffer 3 stacks of {@condition Bleed|TheUndertomesGeneralRules}, or only taking half the damage on a success.

spell.name: Sprouting Lights

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the target suffers an additional {@dice 1d8} piercing damage per round passed and the maximum damage increased by {@dice 3d8} for each second slot level above 5th.

You summon a trio of swirling lights that glow faintly as they fly around one another, spreading a dangeorus pollen around with each wingbeat. As part of casting this spell you may choose to send any number of the three lights to fly above another creature within range, dropping their pollen from high above, preparing the targets body for the violent expulsion of flesh through flowers growing out of them.

You may spend your action on your subsequent turns to have the flowers burst out of the targets, forcing them to pass a Constitution saving throw or suffer {@dice 3d8} piercing damage per round passed since first casting this spell, to a maximum of {@dice 24d8} piercing damage, or half on a success. The build-up of these damage die occurs in a way that if a target has more than one light floating above them, the pollen accumulates faster, making it so a creature with two lights suffers {@dice 6d8} piercing damage per passed round instead of only {@dice 3d8}, yet the maximum value remains as {@dice 24d8} piercing damage.

spell.name: Sprouting Strike

components.m: a seed or piece of bark

entries: You enchant and flick the seed for rapid growth after sticking to the target. You a ranged spell attack against a target creature within reach and dealing 1 piercing damage on a hit. As a Free Action you may take after planting a seed on the creature you may cause it to sprout into heavy vines that dig into the ground, trapping the creature in place until it is destroyed. A creature trapped this has their movement speed reduced to 0.
These vines have 20 Hit Points, an AC of 12 and are Vulnerable to fire and slashing damage. They naturally vanish after one hour, wherein the seed also grows permanently dormant if not sprouted.
You have Advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks to hide the casting of this spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the vines Hit Points increase by 10 and AC increase by 1 for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Star Shower

components.m: A word spoken in a hearts confidence

entries: With a word breathed into the palm of your hands, a hail of showers materializes in glimmering light above your back, shooting away to bathe an area within 60-feet. You may point to any space within reach, and a hail of shooting stairs falls down upon a 15-foot circle around that point. Any creature within reach must pass a Dexterity Saving Throw or take {@damage 3d4} force damage, taking half on a success.

Any creatures who fails this saving throw has a star crash and crumble over them, causing them to glow in a bright light that covers a 30-feet sphere around them. The entire area is also covered in bright lights that cover 30-feet around itself. When you cast this spell, you may choose to deal no damage.
At Higher Levels: When this spell is cast at a level higher than 2nd, it deals another {@damage 2d4} force damage per slot spent above 2nd level.

spell.name: Step Through Heaven's Door
entries: In a moments notice, you clap your hands and have your body transferred to another point within reach, as if you had simply taken a step from a room to another. When you cast this spell, you are teleported instantly to any empty 5-feet space of which you've seen before. You may also choose to spend your reaction in addition to your action to cast this spell as a reaction to failing a Strength or Dexterity Saving Throw, potentially saving yourself from its consequences.
At Higher Levels: When cast with every second spell slot level above 5th ( 7th and 9th ), this spell's range increases by one mile.

spell.name: Sultus Justitia
entries: Summary judgement is in order, despite the veredict. You summon an arcane circle along the surface covered by this spell's range, indiscernible court-room chatter echoing out. Choose up to three creatures within reach, they must pass a Charisma Saving Throw or have ropes of darkness fall from the sky and strangle them by the neck, hoisting them up 5- feet into the air.

While hanging, these creatures suffer 1 level of Exhaustion at the start of their turn and having their movement speed reduced to 0 feet. To become free from this, the rope holding their neck must be cut. It has an AC of 14 and 50 hit points, alongside having vulnerability to fire and slashing damage.
The strangled creature has disadvantage to attacks targeting their own rope. Upon being set free, the creatures hanged recover from half their total Exhaustion, rounded up.

spell.name: Summon Thieving Jacks

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, use the higher level wherever the spell’s level appears in this spell’s description.

You toss away a pumpkin seed imbued with your magic, causing it to nearly explode as it quickly grows into a servant of your own. This creature uses the Thieving Pumpkinhead stat block, except it gains a bonus to it’s AC equal to the spell slot level spent and an additional 15 maximum hit points for that same value. When summoned, the Pumpkinhead has it’s maximum possible amount of hit points as it’s total. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends.

Whenever the Thieving Pumpkinhead uses it’s Steal or be Stolen reaction you may use any abilities it steals directly using your own modifiers instead of the Pumpkinhead’s or the original ability owner. You may also have it swap one of your Attribute scores for the stolen target’s, doing so after the Attribute is determined by the d6.

The creature is an ally to you and your companions. In combat, the creature shares your initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don’t issue any, it takes the Dodge action and uses its move to avoid danger.

spell.name: Summon Wartime Rainfall
entries: You crush the metallic casings in your hand and blow their dust upward to form a localized storm cloud that forms various crimson magic circles that pelt down bullet fire as if raindrops. Choose an area you can see within range, a cloud of bullet hail sprouts to cover a 30-ft. by 30-ft. cube centered at that point.

Any creature must pass a Dexterity saving throw whenever they start or end their turns within that area, suffering {@damage 2d12} piercing damage on a failure, or half on a success. These bullets come from every direction at once, causing Large or greater creatures to suffer one additional damage die as per each additional 5-ft. of space they occupy in a line. ( This only counts a line traced between the start and end of where a creature occupies, such as having Large creatures suffer an additional {@damage 1d12} piercing damage, or Huge ones suffering an additional {@damage 2d12} and so on. )

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by {@damage 1d12} for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Suppressive Fire
entries: Although not very practical for inflicting great damage, this magazine contains a series of compact bullets useful to effectively pin down a target. When used, you may choose a target within your Marksman Weapon's range, it must pass a Dexterity Saving Throw or suffer immense hardship to leave its position, having their movement speed reduced by 5 * SL, to a minimum of 5-feet. In addition, if the target does move during this duration, the next attack aimed against them has your SL as a bonus modifier to hit.

spell.name: Sweet Jabs
entries: All the love in the world will only block up an artery. You point your finger to a creature within reach, a sickeningly pink glow shooting out for them. That creature must pass a Charisma Saving Throw or suffer {@dice 1d4} psychic damage and gain a +1 bonus to their attack and damage rolls, as an overwhelming satisfaction washes over them. On a success, nothing happens.

This damage and effect repeats at the start of the afflicted creature’s turns, up until they have gained a cumulative +3 bonus. If they have a +3 bonus from this effect, at the start of their next turn they instead suffer {@dice 6d12} psychic damage and become {@condition Paralyzed} until the end of their next turn.

spell.name: Sylvan Mark of Extirpation

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the target suffers an additional d4 of Rupture whenever a rule is broken for each second slot level above 5th.

You raise your hand into the air, choosing a target you can see within range and forcing them to levitate 40-ft. up into the air. They must pass a Wisdom saving throw or have their whole body carved with fey magic used to write out many passages in Sylvan. You may choose up to three rules that they must not break for the spell’s duration, as per the following list:

items: You shall not harm this creature. ( Broken if the creature deals damage to a friendly creature of your choice. )
You shall not get close to me. ( Broken if the creature moves toward you within 25-ft. of you after this spell is cast. )
You shall not get away from me. ( Broken if the creature moves further away than 35-ft. of you after this spell is cast. )
You shall not mend your wounds. ( Broken if the creature recovers any amount of hit points. )
You shall not wear this color. ( Broken if the creature is wearing clothing, armor or any suit that is of a color of your choosing at the end of their next turn. )
You shall not stop dancing. ( Broken if the creature moves further than half their total movement speed, as any more than that would require them to stop dancing.

entries: Any time the target breaks a rule, they suffer {@dice 2d4} counts of {@condition Rupture|TheUndertomesGeneralRules}. After casting this spell, the creature falls down 40-ft instantly if they have no fly speed.

You may choose the same rule multiple times, having them all trigger at once on the incident that they are broken. If this spell would have a rule broken because of the targets positioning when its cast, they are moved into the air to the safest nearby space that would not break any rule.

spell.name: Talkative Growth

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the spell’s duration increases by 1 hour for each slot level above 3rd. This spell doesn’t require Concentration when cast with a 6th-level spell slot or greater, and lasts Until Dispelled if cast with a 9-th level spell slot.

You create a small fungal growth on your hand and another on the target creature’s neck, arm or even under their clothes, barely being felt besides of a small bump that shares the target’s warmth. The fungus in your hand has a mouth and replicates any sounds heard within a radius of your choice around the target creature,to a maximum of 60-ft..

There is no limit to how far you may move away from the Growth after it is placed, but it instantly vanished if covered by metal or if you and the target creature is in another plane of existance compared to you. The target creature can only perceive the Growth through an active {@skill Perception} check whose DC is equal to your Spell Save DC plus your {@skill Stealth} modifier. As a reaction to when a creature you can see would try to perceive the Growth while within 30-ft. of you, you may impose disadvantage on that check by moving the Growth to dissolve and reform on another part of the target’s body, possibly making it harder to notice.

spell.name: The Lie of Promised Love
entries: You open your arms towards a creature, using your magic to nudge their mind just so their memories jumble up to have you resemble some old friend or lover, either way a crashing wave of nostalgia and want washes over them, and the desire for a hug is all thats left on their mind. You may choose one creature within reach of this spell, they must pass a Charisma Saving Throw or be forced to use their reaction to run towards the nearest unnocupied 5-feet space within 5-feet of yourself. Upon their arrival, you coax them into a tight embrace, and using the weight of their emotions, you crush the creature within the hug, dealing {@damage 6d8} bludgeoning damage and leaving them {@condition Grappled||grappled} by you, then ending the effect.

A creature that is immune to being {@condition Charmed||charmed} passes this Saving Throw automatically. At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for each slot level above 4th.

spell.name: The Long Silence
entries: The ability to unwind and strip the very concept of time to your will is one that you can briefly tap onto, challenging the rules of the universe so they may bend in your favour. You draw out a complex magical circle that reaches towards a 180-ft. radius around you, causing all things within reach to lose their usual pigmentation as a sepia tone washes over them, their time starting to be melted into a collective mass.
All creatures within reach are asked to “Give up their time.”

by a ghastly voice that rings out through the entire battlefield, being heard in a language that they understand, with even those who don’t speak a language instinctively understanding. A creature who hears this may instantly spend a free action to respond in affirmative or negative, with one of the following effects happening depending on how many creatures have accepted giving up their time:

If more than 13 ( or 70% of the current total creatures within reach, rounded down ) agree to give up their time, they receive it back as all color rushes back into them. All creatures who denied to give up their time are fully stripped of it, being rendered {@condition Paralyzed} for the next three turns, also suffering one point of {@condition Exhaustion} per turn they spend {@condition Paralyzed}. Another creature may spend an Action during their turn while within 5-ft of the {@condition Paralyzed} creature to share their time with them, ending their turn instantly so this effect ends early.

If less than 13 ( or 70% of the current total creatures within reach, rounded down ) refuse to give up their time, only those who accepted become affected with the effects of the Slow spell for the duration of this spell.
If all creatures agree, all within this range are affected with the effects of the Haste spell for this spell’s duration, as the collective mass of time is renovated and boosted.

If none of the creatures agree, a great temporal distortion happens, forcing all creatures to attempt a Constitution Saving Throw or suffer {@dice 8d10} force damage and suffer 2 points of {@condition Exhaustion}, or half that damage and {@condition Exhaustion} on a success.

spell.name: Thirteenth Hour

m.text: An ornate clock worth at least 400 gp, which the spell consumes

entries: You extract the time from the clock in your palm, melting it down to a green-golden pool which dissolves into a mist that flies and glues to the targets skin, causing them to leave afterimages as they move and act faster than they should, overloaded with time for but a moment. You choose a target creature within reach to gain an additional turn that they must take after their next turn in Initiative.

At the end of combat, that creature’s timestream collapses as their adrenaline settles down, making them feel an otherworldly level of {@condition exhaustion}. They suffer one point of {@condition Exhaustion} per time this spell was cast on them during combat.

spell.name: Ticking Clockhand
entries: {@i Chronurgy cantrip.}

You fling an ethereal clock hand toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes {@damage 1d6} piercing damage and suffers 2 {@condition Tremor|TheUndertomesGeneralRules}.
The spell's damage increases by {@damage 1d6} when you reach 5th level ({@damage 2d6}), 11th level ({@damage 3d6}), and 17th level ({@damage 4d6}).

spell.name: Time for Harvest
entries: You shoot out a razor-sharp vine coated in flowers that was bathed in your blood for its initial growth, and let it sink into a target creature to drain them of their life.

You perform a ranged spell attack against a creature within reach that you can see. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 2d12} piercing damage and have the seed sink into their being. For the spell's duration, whenever the target suffers damage they suffer additional piercing damage equal to your spell attack modifier and you recover Hit Points equal to half that amount, rounded down.

If you end your turn more than 60-ft. away from the linked creature, the vine connecting you both is severed and the spell ends early. The vine itself has an AC of 22 and 42 Hit Points, being vulnerable to fire and necrotic damage. Whenever targeted by another creature for a melee attack, the attacking creature suffers {@damage 1d8} piercing damage as its thorns grow to feed.

spell.name: Timed Detonation Bullet
entries: Waiting for the second time to press the trigger is often harder than landing the shot. This bullet contains a small incendiary explosive capable of causing a big wreck. When used, you make a ranged weapon attack against a target within your range. On a hit, a Detonation Bullet is lodged inside them.

You may, as a free action taken whenever there is no ongoing roll, pull a trigger to have the explosive perform its role. The creature containing the bullet must pass a Constitution Saving Throw or take SL * d12 fire damage as if they were Vulnerable to fire damage, or half this damage on a success. In the case of a failure, all creatures within a 15-feet radius of the detonation must pass a Dexterity Saving Throw or take SL * d8 fire damage, or half on a success.

spell.name: Undo Locomotion
entries: {@i Chronurgy spell.}

With a touch, you fling a creature backward through its timestream, causing its body to return to a space it occupied within the last 12 seconds. It appears in the nearest unoccupied space if the original space is obstructed or occupied. Its body defies gravity if the original space remains reachable, causing it to fall if it has no footing. An unwilling target can make a Constitution saving throw, suffering no effect on a success.

entries.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can touch one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Universe Aflame
